{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_0134sRLeMxYXztLZeDpfU6pG","type":"tool_result","content":"=== cli/__init__.py\n\"\"\"Command-line entry point for the ledger.\n\n``main`` resolves the command words, checks the argument count, opens the database, calls the\nhandler, and turns the result into CSV on stdout or one diagnostic line on stderr. It returns the\nexit code and never calls ``sys.exit``; the ``ledger`` launcher is the only caller that does.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom cli import registry\nfrom ledger_core.config import database_path\nfrom ledger_core.errors import LedgerError, Operational\nfrom persistence import Database, open_database\n\nEXIT_OK = 0\nEXIT_OPERATIONAL = 1\nEXIT_USAGE = 2\nPOSTGRES_PREFIXES = (\"postgres://\", \"postgresql://\")\n\n\ndef _usage_error(message: str) -> int:\n    print(f\"usage: {message}\", file=sys.stderr)\n    return EXIT_USAGE\n\n\ndef _open_store(location: str) -> Database:\n    \"\"\"Open the declared store. A SQLite file whose directory is absent is refused, not created.\n\n    The shipped SQLite driver creates a missing parent directory on connect, which would turn a\n    mistyped location into a new, empty store. The ledger's store is provisioned in advance.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not location.startswith(POSTGRES_PREFIXES):\n        parent = Path(location).parent\n        if not parent.is_dir():\n            raise Operational(f\"database directory does not exist: {parent}\")\n    return open_database(location)\n\n\ndef _match(argv: list[str]) -> tuple[tuple[str, ...], registry.Command] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the longest command-word prefix of ``argv`` that is registered, with its command.\"\"\"\n    for length in range(len(argv), 0, -1):\n        words = tuple(argv[:length])\n        if words in registry.COMMANDS:\n            return words, registry.COMMANDS[words]\n    return None\n\n\ndef _format(rows: list[list[str]]) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render rows as unquoted CSV with ``\\\\n`` line endings.\"\"\"\n    return \"\".join(\",\".join(str(value) for value in row) + \"\\n\" for row in rows)\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    argv = sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else list(argv)\n    registry.load()\n\n    matched = _match(argv)\n    if matched is None:\n        return _usage_error(f\"unknown command {' '.join(argv)!r}\" if argv else \"no command given\")\n    words, command = matched\n\n    args = argv[len(words):]\n    if len(args) < command.min_args or (command.max_args is not None and len(args) > command.max_args):\n        return _usage_error(f\"wrong number of arguments for {' '.join(words)!r}\")\n\n    try:\n        database = _open_store(database_path())\n    except Exception as exc:\n        print(f\"error: cannot open database: {exc}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return EXIT_OPERATIONAL\n\n    try:\n        rows = command.handler(database, args)\n    except LedgerError as exc:\n        print(f\"error: {exc}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return exc.exit_code\n    except Exception as exc:\n        print(f\"error: {exc}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return EXIT_OPERATIONAL\n    finally:\n        database.close()\n\n    sys.stdout.write(_format(rows))\n    return EXIT_OK\n=== cli/registry.py\n\"\"\"Command registry: maps command words to handlers, filled from the modules in ``cli/commands/``.\"\"\"\n\nimport importlib\nimport pkgutil\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom typing import Any, NamedTuple\n\nfrom cli import commands\n\n\nclass Command(NamedTuple):\n    \"\"\"One registered command. ``max_args`` is ``None`` when the argument count is unbounded.\"\"\"\n\n    handler: Callable[[Any, list[str]], list[list[str]]]\n    min_args: int\n    max_args: int | None\n\n\n#: Command words, such as ``(\"account\", \"add\")``, mapped to their command.\nCOMMANDS: dict[tuple[str, ...], Command] = {}\n\n\ndef load() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Import every module in ``cli/commands/`` and add its ``COMMANDS``. Idempotent; never removes.\"\"\"\n    for module_info in pkgutil.iter_modules(commands.__path__):\n        module = importlib.import_module(f\"{commands.__name__}.{module_info.name}\")\n        COMMANDS.update(getattr(module, \"COMMANDS\", {}))\n=== cli/testing.py\n\"\"\"In-process command runner for tests. Runs ``main`` without spawning a process.\"\"\"\n\nimport contextlib\nimport io\n\nfrom cli import main\n\n\ndef cli_runner(*args: str) -> tuple[int, str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Return ``(exit_code, stdout, stderr)`` without spawning a process.\"\"\"\n    out, err = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()\n    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out), contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):\n        code = main(list(args))\n    return code, out.getvalue(), err.getvalue()\n=== cli/commands/__init__.py\n\"\"\"Command modules. Each module exposes a ``COMMANDS`` mapping from command words to commands.\"\"\"\n=== cli/commands/accounts.py\n\"\"\"Account commands: ``ledger account add <code> <name>``.\"\"\"\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom ledger_core.accounts import account_row\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Rejected\nfrom ledger_core.money import format_cents\nfrom ledger_core.validation import validate_code, validate_name\n\nACCOUNT_HEADER = [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\n\n\ndef account_add(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Validate, reject a duplicate code, insert the account, and print its row.\"\"\"\n    code = validate_code(args[0])\n    name = validate_name(args[1])\n    if db.accounts.get(account=code) is not None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"account {code} already exists\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=code, name=name)\n    account, stored_name, transactions, cents = account_row(db, code)\n    return [ACCOUNT_HEADER, [account, stored_name, str(transactions), format_cents(cents)]]\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"account\", \"add\"): Command(account_add, 2, 2),\n}\n=== cli/commands/load.py\n\"\"\"``ledger load`` placeholder: reads and header-checks the named CSV file.\n\nWriting the rows is owned by the load-accounts, load-categories, and load-transactions stories, whose\nmodules sort after this one and replace these entries. Until then a readable file with a valid header\nexits 1 because nothing is loaded, rather than reporting a load that did not happen.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom ledger_core.csvio import read_rows\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Operational\n\nHEADERS = {\n    \"accounts\": (\"account\", \"name\"),\n    \"categories\": (\"category\", \"description\"),\n    \"transactions\": (\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"),\n}\n\n\ndef _reader_for(table: str):\n    def handler(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n        read_rows(args[0], HEADERS[table])\n        raise Operational(f\"loading {table} is not implemented yet\")\n\n    return handler\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {(\"load\", table): Command(_reader_for(table), 1, 1) for table in HEADERS}\n=== cli/commands/maintenance.py\n\"\"\"Maintenance commands: ``ledger init`` empties the ledger, ``ledger count`` reports table row counts.\"\"\"\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom ledger_core.config import database_path\nfrom persistence import PersistenceError, open_database\nfrom persistence import db as persistence_db\n\nSCHEMA_SQL = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / \"schema.sql\"\n\n\ndef _ensure_schema() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Create the declared tables when the configured store has none. A provisioned store is left alone.\n\n    This runs on its own connection, before the command's connection first reads. Inside the\n    acceptance harness the command's connection is joined to the harness transaction, which forbids\n    schema SQL and would keep a pre-schema snapshot, so the harness is detached only while the\n    standalone connection is opened. Nothing is written when the tables already exist.\n    \"\"\"\n    harness = persistence_db._harness\n    persistence_db._harness = None\n    try:\n        bootstrap = open_database(database_path())\n    finally:\n        persistence_db._harness = harness\n    try:\n        try:\n            bootstrap.transactions.list()\n        except PersistenceError:\n            bootstrap.execute_script(SCHEMA_SQL.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    finally:\n        bootstrap.close()\n\n\ndef init(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Remove every transaction, then category, then account, in foreign-key order. Prints nothing.\"\"\"\n    _ensure_schema()\n    db.transactions.clear(min_txn_id=0)\n    db.categories.clear(min_category=\"\")\n    db.accounts.clear(min_account=\"\")\n    return []\n\n\ndef count(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Report the stored row count of each table, read from the database on every run.\"\"\"\n    return [\n        [\"table\", \"rows\"],\n        [\"accounts\", str(len(db.accounts.list()))],\n        [\"categories\", str(len(db.categories.list()))],\n        [\"transactions\", str(len(db.transactions.list()))],\n    ]\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"init\",): Command(init, 0, 0),\n    (\"count\",): Command(count, 0, 0),\n}\n=== cli/commands/transactions.py\n\"\"\"Transaction commands: ``ledger txn post <account> <category> <amount> <date> [<memo>]``.\"\"\"\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom ledger_core.balances import Insert, check_no_negative\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Rejected\nfrom ledger_core.money import parse_amount\nfrom ledger_core.transactions import next_txn_id, txn_row\nfrom ledger_core.validation import validate_date, validate_memo\n\nTXN_HEADER = [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n\n\ndef txn_post(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Check every input and the balance rule, then insert one transaction and print its row.\n\n Activates .venv when present and hands off to cli.main.\nset -eu\nROOT=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"$0\")\" && pwd)\"\ncd \"$ROOT\"\nif [ -f .venv/bin/activate ]; then\n    # shellcheck disable=SC1091\n    set +u; . .venv/bin/activate; set -u\nfi\nexec python -c 'import sys; from cli import main; sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))' \"$@\"\n=== ledger_core/__init__.py\n\"\"\"Domain logic for the cash ledger.\n\nOwnership: only the generated ``persistence`` package touches the database.\nModules here never import a database driver, and money is integer cents\neverywhere; floating point is never used for money.\n\"\"\"\n=== ledger_core/accounts.py\n\"\"\"Account rows: the stored account and the live figures the account commands report.\n\n``account_row`` computes the transaction count and the integer-cent balance from the database on\nevery call, so neither figure is stored or embedded.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom persistence import Database\n\nAccountRow = tuple[str, str, int, int]\n\n\ndef account_row(db: Database, code: str) -> AccountRow | None:\n    \"\"\"Return ``(account, name, transactions, balance_cents)``, or ``None`` when the account is absent.\"\"\"\n    account = db.accounts.get(account=code)\n    if account is None:\n        return None\n    posted = db.transactions.list(account=code)\n    return (account.account, account.name, len(posted), sum(txn.amount for txn in posted))\n=== ledger_core/balances.py\n\"\"\"Balance rule: a proposed set of transaction changes must leave no account below zero.\n\nAn account's balance is the sum of its stored transaction amounts in integer cents. The check only\nreads through the persistence interface and never writes.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Union\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import NotFound, Rejected\nfrom persistence import Database\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Insert:\n    \"\"\"A transaction to be added to ``account`` with ``amount`` cents.\"\"\"\n\n    account: str\n    amount: int\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Edit:\n    \"\"\"A stored transaction whose amount becomes ``amount`` cents.\"\"\"\n\n    txn_id: int\n    amount: int\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Delete:\n    \"\"\"A stored transaction to be removed.\"\"\"\n\n    txn_id: int\n\n\nChange = Union[Insert, Edit, Delete]\n\n\ndef current_balance(db: Database, account: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Return the sum of the stored amounts of ``account``; ``0`` when it has none.\"\"\"\n    return sum(row.amount for row in db.transactions.list(account=account))\n\n\ndef _stored(db: Database, txn_id: int):\n    stored = db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n    if stored is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"transaction {txn_id} does not exist\")\n    return stored\n\n\ndef _net_deltas(db: Database, changes: list[Change]) -> dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"Group the changes by account and sum each account's net effect in cents.\"\"\"\n    deltas: dict[str, int] = {}\n    for change in changes:\n        if isinstance(change, Insert):\n            account, delta = change.account, change.amount\n        elif isinstance(change, Edit):\n            stored = _stored(db, change.txn_id)\n            account, delta = stored.account, change.amount - stored.amount\n        elif isinstance(change, Delete):\n            stored = _stored(db, change.txn_id)\n            account, delta = stored.account, -stored.amount\n        else:\n            raise Rejected(f\"unknown transaction change: {change!r}\")\n        deltas[account] = deltas.get(account, 0) + delta\n    return deltas\n\n\ndef check_no_negative(db: Database, changes: list[Change]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Raise ``Rejected`` when any affected account's resulting balance is below zero.\n\n    Changes are judged together by their net effect per account, so their order does not matter.\n    A resulting balance of exactly zero is allowed. Accounts the changes do not touch are not judged.\n    \"\"\"\n    for account, delta in _net_deltas(db, list(changes)).items():\n        resulting = current_balance(db, account) + delta\n        if resulting < 0:\n            raise Rejected(f\"account {account} would be overdrawn by {-resulting} cents\")\n=== ledger_core/config.py\n\"\"\"Runtime configuration: where the ledger database lives.\"\"\"\n\nimport os\n\nDEFAULT_DATABASE_PATH = \"data/app.db\"\nSQLITE_URL_PREFIX = \"sqlite://\"\n\n\ndef _non_empty(name: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the environment variable's value, or None when unset or empty.\"\"\"\n    value = os.environ.get(name)\n    return value if value else None\n\n\ndef database_path() -> str:\n    \"\"\"Resolve the database location.\n\n    Precedence: ``DATABASE_URL`` (with an optional leading ``sqlite://`` removed),\n    then ``DATABASE_PATH``, then ``data/app.db``. Unset or empty values are skipped.\n    \"\"\"\n    url = _non_empty(\"DATABASE_URL\")\n    if url is not None:\n        return url.removeprefix(SQLITE_URL_PREFIX)\n    path = _non_empty(\"DATABASE_PATH\")\n    if path is not None:\n        return path\n    return DEFAULT_DATABASE_PATH\n=== ledger_core/csvio.py\n\"\"\"Shared CSV reader for the ``ledger load`` commands.\n\nThe reader only reads: it never touches the database and never writes to a file.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nfrom collections.abc import Sequence\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Operational, Rejected\n\nRow = tuple[int, list[str]]\n\n\ndef read_rows(path: str, header: Sequence[str]) -> list[Row]:\n    \"\"\"Return ``(line_number, fields)`` for every data row of ``path``, in file order.\n\n    ``header`` lists the column names the table requires, in order. Line numbers are 1-based, so the\n    first data row after a header on line 1 is line 2. Blank lines are skipped. Raises ``Operational``\n    when the file cannot be read or decoded, and ``Rejected`` when the header differs, the file is\n    empty, or a data row's field count differs from ``len(header)``.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        with open(path, newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as fh:\n            return _read(fh, path, list(header))\n    except OSError as exc:\n        raise Operational(f\"cannot read {path}: {exc.strerror or exc}\") from exc\n    except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:\n        raise Operational(f\"cannot decode {path} as UTF-8: {exc}\") from exc\n\n\ndef _read(fh, path: str, header: list[str]) -> list[Row]:\n    reader = csv.reader(fh)\n    try:\n        first = next(reader, None)\n        if first is None:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} is empty; expected header {','.join(header)}\")\n        if first != header:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line 1: header must be {','.join(header)}\")\n        rows: list[Row] = []\n        for fields in reader:\n            if not fields:\n                continue\n            if len(fields) != len(header):\n                raise Rejected(\n                    f\"{path} line {reader.line_num}: expected {len(header)} fields, found {len(fields)}\"\n                )\n            rows.append((reader.line_num, fields))\n        return rows\n    except csv.Error as exc:\n        raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {reader.line_num}: malformed CSV: {exc}\") from exc\n=== ledger_core/errors.py\n\"\"\"Domain errors. Each carries the process exit code the CLI reports.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass LedgerError(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Base class for every domain error the ledger raises.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code: int\n\n\nclass Rejected(LedgerError):\n    \"\"\"Invalid input, duplicate key, unknown reference, account in use, or negative balance.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 3\n\n\nclass NotFound(LedgerError):\n    \"\"\"An account or transaction is absent on get, rename, delete, or amend.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 4\n\n\nclass Operational(LedgerError):\n    \"\"\"An unreadable file or an unopenable database.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 1\n=== ledger_core/money.py\n\"\"\"Conversion between amount text and integer cents.\n\nAmounts are signed integer cents everywhere. Parsing and formatting use integer arithmetic only.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport re\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Rejected\n\n_AMOUNT = re.compile(r\"(-?)([0-9]+)(?:\\.([0-9]{1,2}))?\")\n\n\ndef parse_amount(text: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Parse ``-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`` into integer cents. Zero and three or more decimals are rejected.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(text, str):\n        raise Rejected(\"amount must be text\")\n    match = _AMOUNT.fullmatch(text)\n    if match is None:\n \"0\"))\n    if cents == 0:\n        raise Rejected(\"amount must not be zero\")\n    return -cents if sign else cents\n\n\ndef format_cents(cents: int) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render integer cents with TransactionsGetOutput, TransactionsListOutput\n\nfrom ledger_core.money import format_cents\n\nStoredTxn = Union[TransactionsCreateOutput, TransactionsGetOutput, TransactionsListOutput]\n\n\ndef Nothing here touches\nstorage or prints anything.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport datetime\nimport re\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Rejected\n\nCODE_MAX = 12\nNAME_MAX = 40\nMEMO_MAX = 60\n\n_CODE = re.compile(r\"[A-Z0-9]{1,%d}\" % CODE_MAX)\n_DATE = re.compile(r\"([0-9]{4})-([0-9]{2})-([0-9]{2})\")\n_FORBIDDEN_TEXT = (\",\", \"\\n\", \"\\r\")\n\n\ndef _require_text(value: object, label: str) -> str:\n    if not isinstance(value, str):\n        raise Rejected(f\"{label} must be text\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef _check_length(value: str, label: str, low: int, high: int) -> None:\n    if not low <= len(value) <= high:\n        raise Rejected(f\"{label} must be {low} to {high} characters\")\n\n\ndef _check_plain_text(value: str, label: str) -> None:\n    if any(mark in value for mark in ``0-9``.\"\"\"\n    text = _require_text(value, \"code\")\n    if not _CODE.fullmatch(text):\n        raise Rejected(\"code must be 1 to 12 characters from A-Z and 0-9\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef validate_name(value: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Accept 1 to 40 characters with no comma or newline.\"\"\"\n    text = _require_text(value, \"name\")\n    _check_length(text, \"name\", 1, NAME_MAX)\n    _check_plain_text(text, \"name\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef validate_memo(value: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Accept 0 to 60 characters with no comma or newline.\"\"\"\n    text = _require_text(value, \"memo\")\n    _check_length(text, \"memo\", 0, MEMO_MAX)\n    _check_plain_text(text, \"memo\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef validate_date(value: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Accept a real calendar date year, month, day = (int(part) for part in match.groups())\n    try:\n        datetime.date(year, month, day)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise Rejected(f\"date is not a real calendar date: cli/__init__.py\n\"\"\"Command-line entry point for the ledger.\n\n``main`` resolves the command words, checks the argument count, opens the database, calls the\nhandler, and turns the result into CSV on stdout or one diagnostic line on stderr. It returns the\nexit code and never calls ``sys.exit``; the ``ledger`` launcher is the only caller that does.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom cli import registry\nfrom ledger_core.config import database_path\nfrom ledger_core.errors import LedgerError, Operational\nfrom persistence import Database, open_database\n\nEXIT_OK = 0\nEXIT_OPERATIONAL = 1\nEXIT_USAGE = 2\nPOSTGRES_PREFIXES = (\"postgres://\", \"postgresql://\")\n\n\ndef _usage_error(message: str) -> int:\n    print(f\"usage: {message}\", file=sys.stderr)\n    return EXIT_USAGE\n\n\ndef _open_store(location: str) -> Database:\n    \"\"\"Open the declared store. A SQLite file whose directory is absent is refused, not created.\n\n    The shipped SQLite driver creates a missing parent directory on connect, which would turn a\n    mistyped location into a new, empty store. The ledger's store is provisioned in advance.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not location.startswith(POSTGRES_PREFIXES):\n        parent = Path(location).parent\n        if not parent.is_dir():\n            raise Operational(f\"database directory does not exist: {parent}\")\n    return open_database(location)\n\n\ndef _match(argv: list[str]) -> tuple[tuple[str, ...], registry.Command] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the longest command-word prefix of ``argv`` that is registered, with its command.\"\"\"\n    for length in range(len(argv), 0, -1):\n        words = tuple(argv[:length])\n        if words in registry.COMMANDS:\n            return words, registry.COMMANDS[words]\n    return None\n\n\ndef _format(rows: list[list[str]]) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render rows as unquoted CSV with ``\\\\n`` line endings.\"\"\"\n    return \"\".join(\",\".join(str(value) for value in row) + \"\\n\" for row in rows)\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    argv = sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else list(argv)\n    registry.load()\n\n    matched = _match(argv)\n    if matched is None:\n        return _usage_error(f\"unknown command {' '.join(argv)!r}\" if argv else \"no command given\")\n    words, command = matched\n\n    args = argv[len(words):]\n    if len(args) < command.min_args or (command.max_args is not None and len(args) > command.max_args):\n        return _usage_error(f\"wrong number of arguments for {' '.join(words)!r}\")\n\n    try:\n        database = _open_store(database_path())\n    except Exception as exc:\n        print(f\"error: cannot open database: {exc}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return EXIT_OPERATIONAL\n\n    try:\n        rows = command.handler(database, args)\n    except LedgerError as exc:\n        print(f\"error: {exc}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return exc.exit_code\n    except Exception as exc:\n        print(f\"error: {exc}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return EXIT_OPERATIONAL\n    finally:\n        database.close()\n\n    sys.stdout.write(_format(rows))\n    return EXIT_OK\n=== cli/registry.py\n\"\"\"Command registry: maps command words to handlers, filled from the modules in ``cli/commands/``.\"\"\"\n\nimport importlib\nimport pkgutil\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom typing import Any, NamedTuple\n\nfrom cli import commands\n\n\nclass Command(NamedTuple):\n    \"\"\"One registered command. ``max_args`` is ``None`` when the argument count is unbounded.\"\"\"\n\n    handler: Callable[[Any, list[str]], list[list[str]]]\n    min_args: int\n    max_args: int | None\n\n\n#: Command words, such as ``(\"account\", \"add\")``, mapped to their command.\nCOMMANDS: dict[tuple[str, ...], Command] = {}\n\n\ndef load() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Import every module in ``cli/commands/`` and add its ``COMMANDS``. Idempotent; never removes.\"\"\"\n    for module_info in pkgutil.iter_modules(commands.__path__):\n        module = importlib.import_module(f\"{commands.__name__}.{module_info.name}\")\n        COMMANDS.update(getattr(module, \"COMMANDS\", {}))\n=== cli/testing.py\n\"\"\"In-process command runner for tests. Runs ``main`` without spawning a process.\"\"\"\n\nimport contextlib\nimport io\n\nfrom cli import main\n\n\ndef cli_runner(*args: str) -> tuple[int, str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Return ``(exit_code, stdout, stderr)`` without spawning a process.\"\"\"\n    out, err = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()\n    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out), contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):\n        code = main(list(args))\n    return code, out.getvalue(), err.getvalue()\n=== cli/commands/__init__.py\n\"\"\"Command modules. Each module exposes a ``COMMANDS`` mapping from command words to commands.\"\"\"\n=== cli/commands/accounts.py\n\"\"\"Account commands: ``ledger account add <code> <name>``.\"\"\"\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom ledger_core.accounts import account_row\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Rejected\nfrom ledger_core.money import format_cents\nfrom ledger_core.validation import validate_code, validate_name\n\nACCOUNT_HEADER = [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\n\n\ndef account_add(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Validate, reject a duplicate code, insert the account, and print its row.\"\"\"\n    code = validate_code(args[0])\n    name = validate_name(args[1])\n    if db.accounts.get(account=code) is not None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"account {code} already exists\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=code, name=name)\n    account, stored_name, transactions, cents = account_row(db, code)\n    return [ACCOUNT_HEADER, [account, stored_name, str(transactions), format_cents(cents)]]\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"account\", \"add\"): Command(account_add, 2, 2),\n}\n=== cli/commands/load.py\n\"\"\"``ledger load`` placeholder: reads and header-checks the named CSV file.\n\nWriting the rows is owned by the load-accounts, load-categories, and load-transactions stories, whose\nmodules sort after this one and replace these entries. A provisioned store is left alone.\n\n    This runs on its own connection, before the command's connection first reads. Inside the\n    acceptance harness the command's connection is joined to the harness transaction, which forbids\n    schema SQL and would keep a pre-schema snapshot, so the harness is detached only while the\n    standalone connection is opened. Nothing is written when the tables already exist.\n    \"\"\"\n    harness = persistence_db._harness\n    persistence_db._harness = None\n    try:\n        bootstrap = open_database(database_path())\n    finally:\n        persistence_db._harness = harness\n    try:\n        try:\n            bootstrap.transactions.list()\n        except PersistenceError:\n            bootstrap.execute_script(SCHEMA_SQL.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    finally:\n        bootstrap.close()\n\n\ndef init(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Remove every transaction, then category, then account, in foreign-key order. Prints nothing.\"\"\"\n    _ensure_schema()\n    db.transactions.clear(min_txn_id=0)\n    db.categories.clear(min_category=\"\")\n    db.accounts.clear(min_account=\"\")\n    return []\n\n\ndef count(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Report the stored row count of each table, read from the database on every run.\"\"\"\n    return [\n        [\"table\", \"rows\"],\n        [\"accounts\", str(len(db.accounts.list()))],\n        [\"categories\", str(len(db.categories.list()))],\n        [\"transactions\", str(len(db.transactions.list()))],\n    ]\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"init\",): Command(init, 0, 0),\n    (\"count\",): Command(count, 0, 0),\n}\n=== cli/commands/transactions.py\n\"\"\"Transaction commands: ``ledger txn post <account> <category> <amount> <date> \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n\n\ndef txn_post(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Check every input and the balance rule, then insert one transaction and print its row.\n\n    All checks run before the insert, so a rejected post stores nothing.\n    \"\"\"\n    account, category = args[0], args[1]\n    cents = parse_amount(args[2])\n    day = validate_date(args[3])\n    memo = validate_memo(args[4] if len(args) == 5 else \"\")\n    if db.accounts.get(account=account) is None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"account {account} does not exist\")\n    if db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=next_txn_id(db), date=day, account=account, category=category, amount=cents, memo=memo\n    )\n    return [TXN_HEADER, txn_row(txn)]\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"txn\", \"post\"): Command(txn_post, 4, 5),\n}\n=== ledger\n#!/bin/sh\n# ledger: command-line cash ledger. Activates .venv when present and hands off to cli.main.\nset -eu\nROOT=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"$0\")\" && pwd)\"\ncd \"$ROOT\"\nif [ -f .venv/bin/activate ]; then\n    # shellcheck disable=SC1091\n    set +u; . .venv/bin/activate; set -u\nfi\nexec python -c 'import sys; from cli import main; sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))' \"$@\"\n=== ledger_core/__init__.py\n\"\"\"Domain logic for the cash ledger.\n\nOwnership: only the generated ``persistence`` package touches the database.\nModules here never import a database driver, and money is integer cents\neverywhere; floating point is never used for money.\n\"\"\"\n=== ledger_core/accounts.py\n\"\"\"Account rows: the stored account and the live figures the account commands report.\n\n``account_row`` computes the transaction count and the integer-cent balance from the database on\nevery call, so neither figure is stored or embedded.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom persistence import Database\n\nAccountRow = tuple[str, str, int, int]\n\n\ndef account_row(db: Database, code: str) -> AccountRow | None:\n    \"\"\"Return ``(account, name, transactions, balance_cents)``, or ``None`` when the account is absent.\"\"\"\n    account = db.accounts.get(account=code)\n    if account is None:\n        return None\n    posted = db.transactions.list(account=code)\n    return (account.account, account.name, len(posted), sum(txn.amount for txn in posted))\n=== ledger_core/balances.py\n\"\"\"Balance rule: a proposed set of transaction changes must leave no account below zero.\n\nAn account's balance is the sum of its stored transaction amounts in integer cents. The check only\nreads through the persistence interface and never writes.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Union\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import NotFound, Rejected\nfrom persistence import Database\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Insert:\n    \"\"\"A transaction to be added to ``account`` with ``amount`` cents.\"\"\"\n\n    account: str\n    amount: int\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Edit:\n    \"\"\"A stored transaction whose amount becomes ``amount`` cents.\"\"\"\n\n    txn_id: int\n    amount: int\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Delete:\n    \"\"\"A stored transaction to be removed.\"\"\"\n\n    txn_id: int\n\n\nChange = Union[Insert, Edit, Delete]\n\n\ndef current_balance(db: Database, account: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Return the sum of the stored amounts of ``account``; ``0`` when it has none.\"\"\"\n    return sum(row.amount for row in db.transactions.list(account=account))\n\n\ndef _stored(db: Database, txn_id: int):\n    stored = db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n    if stored is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"transaction {txn_id} does not exist\")\n    return stored\n\n\ndef _net_deltas(db: Database, changes: list[Change]) -> dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"Group the changes by account and sum each account's net effect in cents.\"\"\"\n    deltas: dict[str, int] = {}\n    for change in changes:\n        if isinstance(change, Insert):\n            account, delta = change.account, change.amount\n        elif isinstance(change, Edit):\n            stored = _stored(db, change.txn_id)\n            account, delta = stored.account, change.amount - stored.amount\n        elif isinstance(change, Delete):\n            stored = _stored(db, change.txn_id)\n            account, delta = stored.account, -stored.amount\n        else:\n            raise Rejected(f\"unknown transaction change: {change!r}\")\n        deltas[account] = deltas.get(account, 0) + delta\n    return deltas\n\n\ndef check_no_negative(db: Database, changes: list[Change]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Raise ``Rejected`` when any affected account's resulting balance is below zero.\n\n    Changes are judged together by their net effect per account, so their order does not matter.\n    A resulting balance of exactly zero is allowed. Accounts the changes do not touch are not judged.\n    \"\"\"\n    for account, delta in _net_deltas(db, list(changes)).items():\n        resulting = current_balance(db, account) + delta\n        if resulting < 0:\n            raise Rejected(f\"account {account} would be overdrawn by {-resulting} cents\")\n=== ledger_core/config.py\n\"\"\"Runtime configuration: where the ledger database lives.\"\"\"\n\nimport os\n\nDEFAULT_DATABASE_PATH = \"data/app.db\"\nSQLITE_URL_PREFIX = \"sqlite://\"\n\n\ndef _non_empty(name: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the environment variable's value, or None when unset or empty.\"\"\"\n    value = os.environ.get(name)\n    return value if value else None\n\n\ndef database_path() -> str:\n    \"\"\"Resolve the database location.\n\n    Precedence: ``DATABASE_URL`` (with an optional leading ``sqlite://`` removed),\n    then ``DATABASE_PATH``, then ``data/app.db``. Unset or empty values are skipped.\n    \"\"\"\n    url = _non_empty(\"DATABASE_URL\")\n    if url is not None:\n        return url.removeprefix(SQLITE_URL_PREFIX)\n    path = _non_empty(\"DATABASE_PATH\")\n    if path is not None:\n        return path\n    return DEFAULT_DATABASE_PATH\n=== ledger_core/csvio.py\n\"\"\"Shared CSV reader for the ``ledger load`` commands.\n\nThe reader only reads: it never touches the database and never writes to a file.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nfrom collections.abc import Sequence\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Operational, Rejected\n\nRow = tuple[int, list[str]]\n\n\ndef read_rows(path: str, header: Sequence[str]) -> list[Row]:\n    \"\"\"Return ``(line_number, fields)`` for every data row of ``path``, in file order.\n\n    ``header`` lists the column names the table requires, in order. Line numbers are 1-based, so the\n    first data row after a header on line 1 is line 2. Blank lines are skipped. Raises ``Operational``\n    when the file cannot be read or decoded, and ``Rejected`` when the header differs, the file is\n    empty, or a data row's field count differs from ``len(header)``.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        with open(path, newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as fh:\n            return _read(fh, path, list(header))\n    except OSError as exc:\n        raise Operational(f\"cannot read {path}: {exc.strerror or exc}\") from exc\n    except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:\n        raise Operational(f\"cannot decode {path} as UTF-8: {exc}\") from exc\n\n\ndef _read(fh, path: str, header: list[str]) -> list[Row]:\n    reader = csv.reader(fh)\n    try:\n        first = next(reader, None)\n        if first is None:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} is empty; expected header {','.join(header)}\")\n        if first != header:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line 1: header must be {','.join(header)}\")\n        rows: list[Row] = []\n        for fields in reader:\n            if not fields:\n                continue\n            if len(fields) != len(header):\n                raise Rejected(\n                    f\"{path} line {reader.line_num}: expected {len(header)} fields, found {len(fields)}\"\n                )\n            rows.append((reader.line_num, fields))\n        return rows\n    except csv.Error as exc:\n        raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {reader.line_num}: malformed CSV: {exc}\") from exc\n=== ledger_core/errors.py\n\"\"\"Domain errors. Each carries the process exit code the CLI reports.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass LedgerError(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Base class for every domain error the ledger raises.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code: int\n\n\nclass Rejected(LedgerError):\n    \"\"\"Invalid input, duplicate key, unknown reference, account in use, or negative balance.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 3\n\n\nclass NotFound(LedgerError):\n    \"\"\"An account or transaction is absent on get, rename, delete, or amend.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 4\n\n\nclass Operational(LedgerError):\n    \"\"\"An unreadable file or an unopenable database.\"\"\"\n\n    exit_code = 1\n=== ledger_core/money.py\n\"\"\"Conversion between amount text and integer cents.\n\nAmounts are signed integer cents everywhere. Parsing and formatting use integer arithmetic only.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport re\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Rejected\n\n_AMOUNT = re.compile(r\"(-?)([0-9]+)(?:\\.([0-9]{1,2}))?\")\n\n\ndef parse_amount(text: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Parse ``-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`` into integer cents. Zero and three or more decimals are rejected.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(text, str):\n        raise Rejected(\"amount must be text\")\n    match = _AMOUNT.fullmatch(text)\n    if match is None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"amount must look like -12.50 with at most two decimals: {text!r}\")\n    sign, whole, fraction = match.groups()\n    cents = int(whole) * 100 + int((fraction or \"\").ljust(2, \"0\"))\n    if cents == 0:\n        raise Rejected(\"amount must not be zero\")\n    return -cents if sign else cents\n\n\ndef format_cents(cents: int) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render integer cents with exactly two decimals, a leading ``-`` when negative, no separators.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(cents, int) or isinstance(cents, bool):\n        raise Rejected(\"cents must be an integer\")\n    sign = \"-\" if cents < 0 else \"\"\n    magnitude = abs(cents)\n    return f\"{sign}{magnitude // 100}.{magnitude % 100:02d}\"\n=== ledger_core/transactions.py\n\"\"\"Transaction rows: formatting a stored transaction for output, and the next free transaction id.\"\"\"\n\nfrom typing import Union\n\nfrom persistence import Database\nfrom persistence.schema import TransactionsCreateOutput, TransactionsGetOutput, TransactionsListOutput\n\nfrom ledger_core.money import format_cents\n\nStoredTxn = Union[TransactionsCreateOutput, TransactionsGetOutput, TransactionsListOutput]\n\n\ndef txn_row(txn: StoredTxn) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Format a stored transaction as the output row ``txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo``.\"\"\"\n    return [str(txn.txn_id), txn.date, txn.account, txn.category, format_cents(txn.amount), txn.memo]\n\n\ndef next_txn_id(db: Database) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Return the largest stored ``txn_id`` plus one, or ``1`` when the ledger has no transactions.\"\"\"\n    return max((txn.txn_id for txn in db.transactions.list()), default=0) + 1\n=== ledger_core/validation.py\n\"\"\"Pure validation of codes, names, memos, and dates.\n\nEach function returns the validated value unchanged, or raises ``Rejected``. Nothing here touches\nstorage or prints anything.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport datetime\nimport re\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Rejected\n\nCODE_MAX = 12\nNAME_MAX = 40\nMEMO_MAX = 60\n\n_CODE = re.compile(r\"[A-Z0-9]{1,%d}\" % CODE_MAX)\n_DATE = re.compile(r\"([0-9]{4})-([0-9]{2})-([0-9]{2})\")\n_FORBIDDEN_TEXT = (\",\", \"\\n\", \"\\r\")\n\n\ndef _require_text(value: object, label: str) -> str:\n    if not isinstance(value, str):\n        raise Rejected(f\"{label} must be text\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef _check_length(value: str, label: str, low: int, high: int) -> None:\n    if not low <= len(value) <= high:\n        raise Rejected(f\"{label} must be {low} to {high} characters\")\n\n\ndef _check_plain_text(value: str, label: str) -> None:\n    if any(mark in value for mark in _FORBIDDEN_TEXT):\n        raise Rejected(f\"{label} must not contain a comma or newline\")\n\n\ndef validate_code(value: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Accept 1 to 12 characters, each ``A-Z`` or ``0-9``.\"\"\"\n    text = _require_text(value, \"code\")\n    if not _CODE.fullmatch(text):\n        raise Rejected(\"code must be 1 to 12 characters from A-Z and 0-9\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef validate_name(value: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Accept 1 to 40 characters with no comma or newline.\"\"\"\n    text = _require_text(value, \"name\")\n    _check_length(text, \"name\", 1, NAME_MAX)\n    _check_plain_text(text, \"name\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef validate_memo(value: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Accept 0 to 60 characters with no comma or newline.\"\"\"\n    text = _require_text(value, \"memo\")\n    _check_length(text, \"memo\", 0, MEMO_MAX)\n    _check_plain_text(text, \"memo\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef validate_date(value: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Accept a real calendar date written ``YYYY-MM-DD``.\"\"\"\n    text = _require_text(value, \"date\")\n    match = _DATE.fullmatch(text)\n    if match is None:\n        raise Rejected(\"date must be written YYYY-MM-DD\")\n    year, month, day = (int(part) for part in match.groups())\n    try:\n        datetime.date(year, month, day)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise Rejected(f\"date is not a real calendar date: {text}\") from exc\n    return value","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_0134sRLeMxYXztLZeDpfU6pG","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

cursor.execute(self._driver.select(table, columns, [key]), [identity])\n            return self._build(operation, columns, cursor.fetchone())\n        if verb == \"update\":\n            if not return ()\n\n    def _primary_key(self, table: str) -> str | None:\n        for declared in self._schema.tables:\n            if declared.name == table:\n                return declared.primary_key\n Without a template it does nothing,\nwhich leaves an operator's own pytest run and canonical acceptance unchanged.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport sqlite3\n\nimport pytest\n\nTEMPLATE_VARIABLE = \"DRYDOCK_STORE_TEMPLATE\"\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef _drydock_isolated_store(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    template = os.environ.get(TEMPLATE_VARIABLE, \"\")\n    if template and os.path.isfile(template):\n        store = tmp_path / \"drydock-store.db\"\n        source = sqlite3.connect(f\"file:{template}?mode=ro\", uri=True)\n        target = sqlite3.connect(store)\n        try:\n            source.backup(target)\n        finally:\n            target.close()\n            source.close()\n        monkeypatch.setenv(\"DATABASE_URL\", str(store))\n        monkeypatch.setenv(\"DATABASE_PATH\", str(store))\n    yield","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01UaJfFioyWDkPyZg42WPbVz","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

Connection\n    handling is internal and may change without affecting any caller.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, dsn: str, schema: Schema, *, driver: Driver | None = None) -> None:\n        self._rollback_owner = None\n        self._schema = schema\n        driver = driver if driver is not None else open_driver(dsn)\n        self._harness = _harness\n        self._driver = self._harness.join(driver) if self._harness is not None else driver\n        grouped = schema.by_table()\n        for table in schema.tables:\n            setattr(self, table.name, TableAccess(table, grouped.get(table.name, ()), self))\n\n    @property\n    def driver(self) -> Driver:\n        if self._harness is not None:\n            raise PersistenceError(\"driver access is forbidden inside the acceptance transaction\")\n        if self._rollback_owner is not None:\n            raise PersistenceError(\"driver access is forbidden inside a rollback session\")\n        return self._driver\n\n    def close(self) -> None:\n        if self._harness is not None:\n            return  # the acceptance harness owns the shared connection\n        if self._rollback_owner is not None:\n            raise PersistenceError(\"the rollback session owns connection lifetime\")\n        self._driver.close()\n\n    @contextmanager\n    def rollback_session(self):\n        \"\"\"Use this connection for setup, behavior and assertions; always roll back.\n\n        Normal calls remain autocommitted. No schema creation, nested transaction,\n        driver escape, or cross-thread operation is allowed in this scope. Under the acceptance\n        harness the scope is the harness's transaction, rolled back when the criterion ends, so\n        leaving it rolls nothing back.\n        \"\"\"\n        if self._harness is not None:\n            yield self\n            return\n        if self._rollback_owner is not None:\n            raise PersistenceError(\"nested rollback session\")\n        connection = self._driver.connect()\n        cursor = connection.cursor()\n        try:\n            cursor.execute(\"BEGIN\")\n            self._rollback_owner = threading.get_ident()\n            try:\n                yield self\n            finally:\n                try:\n                    cursor.execute(\"ROLLBACK\")\n                except Exception as exc:\n                    raise PersistenceError(f\"acceptance rollback failed: {exc}\") from exc\n                finally:\n                    self._rollback_owner = None\n        finally:\n            cursor.close()\n            self._driver.close()\n\n    def __enter__(self) -> Database:\n        return self\n\n    def __exit__(self, *_: object) -> None:\n        self.close()\n\n    def execute_script(self, sql: str) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Apply generated DDL. The schema is built once, at the DATABASE build step.\"\"\"\n        if self._rollback_owner is not None or self._harness is not None:\n            raise PersistenceError(\"schema and transaction SQL are forbidden in rollback sessions\")\n        cursor = self._open(\"schema\")\n        try:\n            for statement in statements(self._driver.prepare_schema(sql)):\n                cursor.execute(statement)\n        finally:\n            cursor.close()\n\n    def run(self, operation: Operation, arguments: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Any:\n        \"\"\"Execute one declared operation with bound parameters.\"\"\"\n        unknown = sorted(set(arguments) - set(operation.inputs))\n        if unknown:\n            raise PersistenceError(\n                f\"{operation.identifier} does not accept {', '.join(unknown)}. Declared inputs: \"\n                f\"{', '.join(operation.inputs) or 'none'}.\"\n            )\n        if operation not in self._schema.operations:\n            raise UnknownOperation(f\"{operation.identifier} is not a declared operation\")\n        missing = [name for name in self._match(operation) if name not in arguments]\n        if missing:\n            raise PersistenceError(f\"{operation.identifier} requires {', '.join(missing)}\")\n        if operation.verb == \"delete\" and not arguments:\n            raise PersistenceError(f\"{operation.identifier} requires a delete predicate\")\n        names = [name for name in operation.inputs if name in arguments]\n        values = [arguments[name] for name in names]\n        # The harness's one connection serves the criterion and the application's request\n        # threads alike, so an operation holds it for its whole statement and savepoint.\n        with self._harness.lock if self._harness is not None else nullcontext():\n            scoped = self._rollback_owner is not None or self._harness is not None\n            cursor = self._open(operation.identifier)\n            try:\n                if scoped:\n                    cursor.execute(\"SAVEPOINT drydock_operation\")\n                result = self._dispatch(operation, cursor, names, values)\n                if scoped:\n                    cursor.execute(\"RELEASE SAVEPOINT drydock_operation\")\n                return result\n            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - translated at the boundary on purpose\n                if scoped:\n                    cursor.execute(\"ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT drydock_operation\")\n                    cursor.execute(\"RELEASE SAVEPOINT drydock_operation\")\n                raise PersistenceError(f\"{operation.identifier} failed: {exc}\") from exc\n            finally:\n                cursor.close()\n\n    def _open(self, action: str) -> Any:\n        \"\"\"Return a cursor, translating a refused or failed connection.\"\"\"\n        if self._rollback_owner not in (None, threading.get_ident()):\n            raise PersistenceError(\"rollback session requires its owning thread and connection\")\n        try:\n            return self._driver.connect().cursor()\n        except PersistenceError:\n            raise\n        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - translated at the boundary on purpose\n            raise PersistenceError(f\"{action} could not connect: {exc}\") from exc\n\n    def _dispatch(\n        self,\n        operation: Operation,\n        cursor: Any,\n        names: list[str],\n        values: list[Any],\n    def _open(self, *, check_same_thread: bool = True) -> sqlite3.Connection:\n        if self._path != \":memory:\":\n            Path(self._path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        # Autocommit by default; an explicit BEGIN suspends it until ROLLBACK.\n        connection = sqlite3.connect(\n            self._path, isolation_level=None, check_same_thread=check_same_thread\n        )\n        connection.execute(\"PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL\")\n        connection.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON\")\n        return connection\n\n    def close(self) -> None:\n        if self._pinned is not None:\n            self._pinned.close()\n            self._pinned = None\n            return\n        connection = getattr(self._local, \"connection\", None)\n        if connection is not None:\n            connection.close()\n            self._local.connection = None\n\nclass TableAccess:\n    \"\"\"The methods one table grants, bound from the declaration rather than defined by hand.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, table: Table, operations: Iterable[Operation], database: Database) -> None:\n        self._table = table\n        self._database = database\n        self._operations = {operation.name or operation.verb: operation for operation in operations}\n\n    def __repr__(self) -> str:\n        granted = \", \".join(sorted(self._operations))\n        return f\"<TableAccess {self._table.name}: {granted or 'no declared operation'}>\"\n\n    def __getattr__(self, name: str) -> Callable[..., Any]:\n        operation = self._operations.get(name)\n        if operation is None:\n            granted = \", \".join(sorted(self._operations)) or \"none\"\n            raise UnknownOperation(\n                f\"{self._table.name} declares no {name!r} operation. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01WM4UhDrpN48N5QLT7BG18F","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"``ledger load`` placeholder: reads and header-checks the named CSV file.\n2\t\n3\tWriting the rows is owned by the load-accounts, load-categories, and load-transactions stories, whose\n4\tmodules sort after this one and replace these entries. Until then a readable file with a valid header\n5\texits 1 because nothing is loaded, rather than reporting a load that did not happen.\n6\t\"\"\"\n7\t\n8\tfrom cli.registry import Command\n9\tfrom ledger_core.csvio import read_rows\n10\tfrom ledger_core.errors import Operational\n11\t\n12\tHEADERS = {\n13\t    \"accounts\": (\"account\", \"name\"),\n14\t    \"categories\": (\"category\", \"description\"),\n15\t    \"transactions\": (\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"),\n16\t}\n17\t\n18\t\n19\tdef _reader_for(table: str):\n20\t    def handler(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n21\t        read_rows(args[0], HEADERS[table])\n22\t        raise Operational(f\"loading {table} is not implemented yet\")\n23\t\n24\t    return handler\n25\t\n26\t\n27\tCOMMANDS = {(\"load\", table): Command(_reader_for(table), 1, 1) for table in HEADERS}\n28\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"a5e5a66d-028e-457d-a13f-1e4d1e551a13","uuid":"19397bc6-5eb5-4b3a-aaa9-1c1a4fa20bc5","timestamp":"2026-10-27T14:47:38.035Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/cli/commands/load.py","content":"\"\"\"``ledger load`` placeholder: reads and header-checks the named CSV file.\n\nWriting the rows is owned by the load-accounts, load-categories, and load-transactions stories, whose\nmodules sort after this one and replace these entries. Until then a readable file with a valid header\nexits 1 because nothing is loaded, rather than reporting a load that did not happen.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom ledger_core.csvio import read_rows\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Operational\n\nHEADERS = {\n    \"accounts\": (\"account\", \"name\"),\n    \"categories\": (\"category\", \"description\"),\n    \"transactions\": (\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"),\n}\n\n\ndef _reader_for(table: str):\n    def handler(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n        read_rows(args[0], HEADERS[table])\n        raise Operational(f\"loading {table} is not implemented yet\")\n\n    return handler\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {(\"load\", table): Command(_reader_for(table), 1, 1) for table in HEADERS}\n","numLines":28,"startLine":1,"totalLines":28}},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01WM4UhDrpN48N5QLT7BG18F","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgSvbdvZuDso9mNHesG3v","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01MsHeBL6ZCYBVDi1RKTnPt1","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/cli/commands/load.py","content":"\"\"\"``ledger load`` commands: ``accounts`` and ``categories`` are all-or-nothing bulk loads.\n\nEvery row of the file is checked before the first write: the key, the text, the key's repetition\nwithin the file, and the key's presence in the store. The rows are then inserted through\n``ledger_core.atomic.run_all``, so a failing insert removes the rows already stored.\n\n``transactions`` is still a placeholder: it reads and header-checks the file, then exits 1 because\nnothing is loaded, rather than reporting a load that did not happen.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom collections.abc import Callable, Iterable\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom ledger_core.atomic import run_all\nfrom ledger_core.csvio import read_rows\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Operational, Rejected\nfrom ledger_core.validation import validate_code, validate_name\n\nACCOUNT_HEADER = (\"account\", \"name\")\nCATEGORY_HEADER = (\"category\", \"description\")\nTRANSACTION_HEADER = (\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\")\n\n\ndef _checked_rows(\n    path: str,\n    header: tuple[str, str],\n    validate_key: Callable[[str], str],\n    stored: Iterable[str],\n) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"Validate every row of ``path`` before any write; return ``(key, text)`` pairs in file order.\"\"\"\n    already_stored = set(stored)\n    seen: set[str] = set()\n    checked: list[tuple[str, str]] = []\n    for line, (key_text, text) in read_rows(path, header):\n        try:\n            key = validate_key(key_text)\n            validate_name(text)\n        except Rejected as exc:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {line}: {exc}\") from exc\n        if key in seen:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {line}: code {key} repeats within the file\")\n        if key in already_stored:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {line}: code {key} is already stored\")\n        seen.add(key)\n        checked.append((key, text))\n    return checked\n\n\ndef _load(\n    path: str,\n    header: tuple[str, str],\n    table: str,\n    validate_key: Callable[[str], str],\n    stored: Iterable[str],\n    create: Callable[[str, str], object],\n    remove: Callable[[str], object],\n) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Check the whole file, insert every row as one unit, and report the loaded count.\"\"\"\n    checked = _checked_rows(path, header, validate_key, stored)\n    run_all([(_insert(create, key, text), _remove(remove, key)) for key, text in checked])\n    return [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [table, str(len(checked))]]\n\n\ndef _insert(create: Callable[[str, str], object], key: str, text: str) -> Callable[[], object]:\n    return lambda: create(key, text)\n\n\ndef _remove(remove: Callable[[str], object], key: str) -> Callable[[], object]:\n    return lambda: remove(key)\n\n\ndef load_accounts(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Load ``account,name`` rows from ``args[0]``; nothing is stored unless every row is valid.\"\"\"\n    return _load(\n        args[0],\n        ACCOUNT_HEADER,\n        \"accounts\",\n        validate_code,\n        (row.account for row in db.accounts.list()),\n        lambda key, name: db.accounts.create(account=key, name=name),\n        lambda key: db.accounts.delete(account=key),\n    )\n\n\ndef load_categories(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Load ``category,description`` rows from ``args[0]``; nothing is stored unless every row is valid.\"\"\"\n    return _load(\n        args[0],\n        CATEGORY_HEADER,\n        \"categories\",\n        validate_code,\n        (row.category for row in db.categories.list()),\n        lambda key, text: db.categories.create(category=key, description=text),\n        lambda key: db.categories.delete(category=key),\n    )\n\n\ndef _transactions_placeholder(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    read_rows(args[0], TRANSACTION_HEADER)\n    raise Operational(\"loading transactions is not implemented yet\")\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"load\", \"accounts\"): Command(load_accounts, 1, 1),\n    (\"load\", \"categories\"): Command(load_categories, 1, 1),\n    (\"load\", \"transactions\"): Command(_transactions_placeholder, 1, 1),\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2041,"cache_read_input_tokens":87807,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2041},"output_tokens":9,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"a5e5a66d-028e-457d-a13f-1e4d1e551a13","uuid":"63da4805-cc63-4c31-abbe-90d53fabaea0","timestamp":"2026-10-27T14:47:53.940Z","request_id":"req_011CgSvbdfhDTcjyEw3ZeJzU","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_01MsHeBL6ZCYBVDi1RKTnPt1":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/cli/commands/load.py","content":"\"\"\"``ledger load`` commands: ``accounts`` and ``categories`` are all-or-nothing bulk loads.\n\nEvery row of the file is checked before the first write: the key, the text, the key's repetition\nwithin the file, and the key's presence in the store. return ``(key, text)`` pairs in file order.\"\"\"\n    already_stored = set(stored)\n    seen: set[str] = set()\n    checked: list[tuple[str, str]] = []\n    for line, (key_text, text) in read_rows(path, header):\n        try:\n            key = validate_key(key_text)\n            validate_name(text)\n        except Rejected as exc:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {line}: {exc}\") from exc\n        if key in seen:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {line}: code {key} repeats within the file\")\n        if key in already_stored:\n            raise Rejected(f\"{path} line {line}: code {key} is already stored\")\n        seen.add(key)\n        checked.append((key, text))\n    return checked\n\n\ndef _load(\n    path: str,\n    header: tuple[str, str],\n    table: str,\n    validate_key: Callable[[str], str],\n    stored: Iterable[str],\n    create: Callable[[str, str], object],\n    remove: Callable[[str], object],\n) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Check the whole file, insert every row as one unit, and report the loaded count.\"\"\"\n    checked = _checked_rows(path, header, validate_key, stored)\n    run_all([(_insert(create, key, text), _remove(remove, key)) for key, text in checked])\n    return [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [table, str(len(checked))]]\n\n\ndef _insert(create: Callable[[str, str], object], key: str, text: str) -> Callable[[], object]:\n    return lambda: create(key, text)\n\n\ndef _remove(remove: Callable[[str], object], key: str) -> Callable[[], object]:\n    return lambda: remove(key)\n\n\ndef load_accounts(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Load ``account,name`` rows from ``args[0]``; nothing is stored unless every row is valid.\"\"\"\n    return _load(\n        args[0],\n        ACCOUNT_HEADER,\n        \"accounts\",\n        validate_code,\n        (row.account for row in db.accounts.list()),\n        lambda key, name: db.accounts.create(account=key, name=name),\n        lambda key: db.accounts.delete(account=key),\n    )\n\n\ndef load_categories(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Load ``category,description`` rows from ``args[0]``; nothing is stored unless every row is valid.\"\"\"\n    return _load(\n        args[0],\n        CATEGORY_HEADER,\n        \"categories\",\n        validate_code,\n        (row.category for row in db.categories.list()),\n        lambda key, text: db.categories.create(category=key, description=text),\n        lambda key: db.categories.delete(category=key),\n    )\n\n\ndef _transactions_placeholder(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    read_rows(args[0], TRANSACTION_HEADER)\n    raise Operational(\"loading transactions is not implemented yet\")\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"load\", \"accounts\"): Command(load_accounts, 1, 1),\n    (\"load\", \"categories\"): Command(load_categories, 1, 1),\n    (\"load\", \"transactions\"): Command(_transactions_placeholder, 1, 1),\n}\n"}}}

nothing is stored unless every row is valid.\"\"\"","+    return _load(","+        args[0],","+        CATEGORY_HEADER,","+        \"categories\",","+        validate_code,","+        (row.category for row in db.categories.list()),","+        lambda key, text: db.categories.create(category=key, description=text),","+        lambda key: db.categories.delete(category=key),","+    )","+","+","+def _transactions_placeholder(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:","+    read_rows(args[0], TRANSACTION_HEADER)","+    raise Operational(\"loading transactions is not implemented yet\")","+","+","+COMMANDS = {","+    (\"load\", \"accounts\"): Command(load_accounts, 1, 1),","+    (\"load\", \"categories\"): Command(load_categories, 1, 1),","+    (\"load\", \"transactions\"): Command(_transactions_placeholder, 1, 1),","+}"]}],"originalFile":"\"\"\"``ledger load`` placeholder: reads and header-checks the named CSV file.\n\nWriting the rows is owned by the load-accounts, load-categories, and load-transactions stories, whose\nmodules sort after this one and replace these entries. Until then a readable file with a valid header\nexits 1 because nothing is loaded, rather than reporting a load that did not happen.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom ledger_core.csvio import read_rows\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Operational\n\nHEADERS = {\n    \"accounts\": (\"account\", \"name\"),\n    \"categories\": (\"category\", \"description\"),\n    \"transactions\": (\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"),\n}\n\n\ndef _reader_for(table: str):\n    def handler(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n        read_rows(args[0], HEADERS[table])\n        raise Operational(f\"loading {table} is not implemented yet\")\n\n    return handler\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {(\"load\", table): Command(_reader_for(table), 1, 1) for table in HEADERS}\n","userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01MsHeBL6ZCYBVDi1RKTnPt1","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgSvcnsrE9sBM9XGbb2Wx","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Au9h56drw46ihE1YPSuNnR","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/cli/commands/accounts.py","content":"\"\"\"Account commands: ``ledger account add|get|rename|delete``.\"\"\"\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom ledger_core.accounts import account_row\nfrom ledger_core.errors import NotFound, Rejected\nfrom ledger_core.money import format_cents\nfrom ledger_core.validation import validate_code, validate_name\n\nACCOUNT_HEADER = [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\nDELETED_HEADER = [\"deleted\"]\n\n\ndef _account_rows(db, code: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Return the header and the live row for ``code``; raise ``NotFound`` when it is absent.\"\"\"\n    row = account_row(db, code)\n    if row is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"account {code} does not exist\")\n    account, name, transactions, cents = row\n    return [ACCOUNT_HEADER, [account, name, str(transactions), format_cents(cents)]]\n\n\ndef account_add(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Validate, reject a duplicate code, insert the account, and print its row.\"\"\"\n    code = validate_code(args[0])\n    name = validate_name(args[1])\n    if db.accounts.get(account=code) is not None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"account {code} already exists\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=code, name=name)\n    return _account_rows(db, code)\n\n\ndef account_get(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Print the account's live row. Read-only; an absent code exits 4.\"\"\"\n    return _account_rows(db, args[0])\n\n\ndef account_rename(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Validate the new name, then change only the name of an existing account and print its row.\"\"\"\n    code, name = args[0], validate_name(args[1])\n    if db.accounts.get(account=code) is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"account {code} does not exist\")\n    db.accounts.update(account=code, name=name)\n    return _account_rows(db, code)\n\n\ndef account_delete(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Remove an account that has no transactions. Existence and use are both checked first.\"\"\"\n    code = args[0]\n    if db.accounts.get(account=code) is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"account {code} does not exist\")\n    if db.transactions.list(account=code):\n        raise Rejected(f\"account {code} has transactions and cannot be deleted\")\n    db.accounts.delete(account=code)\n    return [DELETED_HEADER, [code]]\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"account\", \"add\"): Command(account_add, 2, 2),\n    (\"account\", \"get\"): Command(account_get, 1, 1),\n    (\"account\", \"rename\"): Command(account_rename, 2, 2),\n    (\"account\", \"delete\"): Command(account_delete, 1, 1),\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":4102,"cache_read_input_tokens":89848,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":4102},"output_tokens":7,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"a5e5a66d-028e-457d-a13f-1e4d1e551a13","uuid":"b390e53e-2f70-4081-b3c6-c3769a95db6f","timestamp":"2026-10-27T14:47:59.969Z","request_id":"req_011CgSvcnV3aFtwYG49vorWo","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_01Au9h56drw46ihE1YPSuNnR":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/cli/commands/accounts.py","content":"\"\"\"Account Read-only; an absent code exits 4.\"\"\"\n    return _account_rows(db, args[0])\n\n\ndef account_rename(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Validate the new name, then change only the name of an existing account and print its row.\"\"\"\n    code, name = args[0], validate_name(args[1])\n    if db.accounts.get(account=code) is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"account {code} does not exist\")\n    db.accounts.update(account=code, name=name)\n    return _account_rows(db, code)\n\n\ndef account_delete(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Remove an account that has no transactions. Existence and use are both checked first.\"\"\"\n    code = args[0]\n    if db.accounts.get(account=code) is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"account {code} does not exist\")\n    if db.transactions.list(account=code):\n        raise Rejected(f\"account {code} has transactions and cannot be deleted\")\n    db.accounts.delete(account=code)\n    return [DELETED_HEADER, [code]]\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"account\", \"add\"): Command(account_add, 2, 2),\n    (\"account\", \"get\"): Command(account_get, 1, 1),\n    (\"account\", \"rename\"): Command(account_rename, 2, 2),\n    (\"account\", \"delete\"): Command(account_delete, 1, 1),\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":14,"newStart":1,"newLines":24,"lines":["-\"\"\"Account commands: ``ledger account add <code> <name>``.\"\"\"","+\"\"\"Account commands: ``ledger account add|get|rename|delete``.\"\"\""," "," from cli.registry import Command"," from ledger_core.accounts import account_row","-from ledger_core.errors import Rejected","+from ledger_core.errors import NotFound, Rejected"," from ledger_core.money import format_cents"," from ledger_core.validation import validate_code, validate_name"," "," ACCOUNT_HEADER = [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]","+DELETED_HEADER = [\"deleted\"]"," "," ","+def _account_rows(db, code: str) -> list[list[str]]:","+    \"\"\"Return the header and the live row for ``code``; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgSvdDwyhUpUWJuY36McA","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Aa3L9qZAfFRcDrHzTbJcSn","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/cli/commands/transactions.py","content":"\"\"\"Transaction commands: ``ledger txn post|get|delete|amend``.\"\"\"\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom ledger_core.balances import Delete, Edit, Insert, check_no_negative\nfrom ledger_core.errors import NotFound, Rejected\nfrom ledger_core.money import parse_amount\nfrom ledger_core.transactions import next_txn_id, parse_txn_id, txn_row\nfrom ledger_core.validation import validate_date, validate_memo\n\nTXN_HEADER = [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\nDELETED_HEADER = [\"deleted\"]\n\n\ndef txn_post(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Check every input and the balance rule, then insert one transaction and print its row.\n\n    All checks run before the insert, so a rejected post stores nothing.\n    \"\"\"\n    account, category = args[0], args[1]\n    cents = parse_amount(args[2])\n    day = validate_date(args[3])\n    memo = validate_memo(args[4] if len(args) == 5 else \"\")\n    if db.accounts.get(account=account) is None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"account {account} does not exist\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=category) is None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"category {category} does not exist\")\n    check_no_negative(db, [Insert(account=account, amount=cents)])\n    txn = db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=next_txn_id(db), date=day, account=account, category=category, amount=cents, memo=memo\n    )\n    return [TXN_HEADER, txn_row(txn)]\n\n\ndef txn_get(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Print one stored transaction. Read-only; a non-integer id exits 3 and an absent id exits 4.\"\"\"\n    txn_id = parse_txn_id(args[0])\n    txn = db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n    if txn is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"transaction {txn_id} does not exist\")\n    return [TXN_HEADER, txn_row(txn)]\n\n\ndef txn_delete(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Remove a transaction unless its account balance would go below zero without it.\"\"\"\n    txn_id = parse_txn_id(args[0])\n    if db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id) is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"transaction {txn_id} does not exist\")\n    check_no_negative(db, [Delete(txn_id=txn_id)])\n    db.transactions.delete(txn_id=txn_id)\n    return [DELETED_HEADER, [str(txn_id)]]\n\n\ndef txn_amend(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Change only the amount of a transaction, and only when its account stays at or above zero.\"\"\"\n    txn_id = parse_txn_id(args[0])\n    cents = parse_amount(args[1])\n    if db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id) is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"transaction {txn_id} does not exist\")\n    check_no_negative(db, [Edit(txn_id=txn_id, amount=cents)])\n    txn = db.transactions.update(txn_id=txn_id, amount=cents)\n    return [TXN_HEADER, txn_row(txn)]\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"txn\", \"post\"): Command(txn_post, 4, 5),\n    (\"txn\", \"get\"): Command(txn_get, 1, 1),\n    (\"txn\", \"delete\"): Command(txn_delete, 1, 1),\n    (\"txn\", \"amend\"): Command(txn_amend, 2, 2),\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1449,"cache_read_input_tokens":93950,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1449},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"a5e5a66d-028e-457d-a13f-1e4d1e551a13","uuid":"c1809960-4736-4d06-ac1c-c341093df9df","timestamp":"2026-10-27T14:48:05.615Z","request_id":"req_011CgSvdDcQ65Bz9oquMe8qw","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_01Aa3L9qZAfFRcDrHzTbJcSn":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/cli/commands/transactions.py","content":"\"\"\"Transaction {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgSvde1pvmLv2sqVGuAUK","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01MM5SKqKWjDrMfQuYAq96Uu","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/cli/commands/transfers.py","content":"\"\"\"Transfer command: ``ledger transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>``, two linked rows stored together.\"\"\"\n\nfrom functools import partial\n\nfrom cli.registry import Command\nfrom ledger_core.atomic import run_all\nfrom ledger_core.balances import Insert, check_no_negative\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Rejected\nfrom ledger_core.money import parse_amount\nfrom ledger_core.transactions import next_txn_id, txn_row\nfrom ledger_core.validation import validate_date\n\nTRANSFER_CATEGORY = \"TRANSFER\"\nTXN_HEADER = [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n\n\ndef transfer(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Move cash between two accounts as an outgoing and an incoming row, or store neither.\n\n    Every check, including the source balance after the debit, runs before the first insert.\n    \"\"\"\n    source, target = args[0], args[1]\n    cents = parse_amount(args[2])\n    if cents < 0:\n        raise Rejected(\"transfer amount must be positive\")\n    day = validate_date(args[3])\n    if source == target:\n        raise Rejected(\"transfer needs two different accounts\")\n    if db.accounts.get(account=source) is None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"account {source} does not exist\")\n    if db.accounts.get(account=target) is None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"account {target} does not exist\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=TRANSFER_CATEGORY) is None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"category {TRANSFER_CATEGORY} does not exist\")\n    check_no_negative(db, [Insert(account=source, amount=-cents)])\n\n    first_id = next_txn_id(db)\n    outgoing = {\n        \"txn_id\": first_id,\n        \"date\": day,\n        \"account\": source,\n        \"category\": TRANSFER_CATEGORY,\n        \"amount\": -cents,\n        \"memo\": f\"transfer to {target}\",\n    }\n    incoming = {\n        \"txn_id\": first_id + 1,\n        \"date\": day,\n        \"account\": target,\n        \"category\": TRANSFER_CATEGORY,\n        \"amount\": cents,\n        \"memo\": f\"transfer from {source}\",\n    }\n    stored = []\n\n    def insert(fields: dict):\n        stored.append(db.transactions.create(**fields))\n\n    run_all(\n        [\n            (partial(insert, outgoing), partial(db.transactions.delete, txn_id=outgoing[\"txn_id\"])),\n            (partial(insert, incoming), partial(db.transactions.delete, txn_id=incoming[\"txn_id\"])),\n        ]\n    )\n    return [TXN_HEADER] + [txn_row(txn) for txn in stored]\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"transfer\",): Command(transfer, 4, run_all\nfrom ledger_core.balances import Insert, check_no_negative\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Rejected\nfrom ledger_core.money import parse_amount\nfrom ledger_core.transactions import next_txn_id, txn_row\nfrom ledger_core.validation import validate_date\n\nTRANSFER_CATEGORY = \"TRANSFER\"\nTXN_HEADER = [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n\n\ndef transfer(db, args: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Move cash between two accounts as an outgoing and an incoming row, or store neither.\n\n    Every check, including the source balance after the debit, runs before the first insert.\n    \"\"\"\n    source, target = args[0], args[1]\n    cents = parse_amount(args[2])\n    if cents < 0:\n        raise not exist\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=TRANSFER_CATEGORY) is None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"category {TRANSFER_CATEGORY} does not exist\")\n    check_no_negative(db, [Insert(account=source, stored.append(db.transactions.create(**fields))\n\n    run_all(\n        [\n            (partial(insert, outgoing), partial(db.transactions.delete, txn_id=outgoing[\"txn_id\"])),\n            (partial(insert, incoming), partial(db.transactions.delete, txn_id=incoming[\"txn_id\"])),\n        ]\n    )\n    return [TXN_HEADER] + [txn_row(txn) for txn in stored]\n\n\nCOMMANDS = {\n    (\"transfer\",): Command(transfer, 4, 4),\n}\n"}}}
