{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgSvfnCGC6YYHomyhFe4x","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01PE1LxzyybfAbHjCw4JW1og","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/tests/test_load.py","content":"\"\"\"``ledger load accounts`` and ``ledger load categories``: all-or-nothing bulk loads with read-back.\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence import db as persistence_db\nfrom persistence import PersistenceError\n\nACCOUNT_HEADER = [\"account\", \"name\"]\nCATEGORY_HEADER = [\"category\", \"description\"]\n\n\ndef _write(path, header, rows) -> str:\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as fh:\n        writer = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        writer.writerow(header)\n        writer.writerows(rows)\n    return str(path)\n\n\ndef _rows(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef _accounts(store_open, path):\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        return {row.account: row.name for row in db.accounts.list()}\n\n\ndef _categories(store_open, path):\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        return {row.category: row.description for row in db.categories.list()}\n\n\n# ── accounts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_accounts_load_reports_count_and_reads_back(ledger_store, store_open, tmp_path):\n    rows = [[\"ZLA1\", \"Load One\"], [\"ZLA2\", \"Load Two\"], [\"ZLA3\", \"Load Three\"]]\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"accounts.csv\", ACCOUNT_HEADER, rows)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"accounts\", \"3\"]]\n    assert _accounts(store_open, ledger_store) == {acct: name for acct, name in rows}\n\n\ndef test_accounts_header_only_loads_zero_rows(ledger_store, tmp_path):\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"accounts.csv\", ACCOUNT_HEADER, [])\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"accounts\", \"0\"]]\n\n\ndef test_accounts_load_accepts_largest_code_and_name(ledger_store, store_open, tmp_path):\n    rows = [[\"Z\" * 12, \"n\" * 40]]\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"accounts.csv\", ACCOUNT_HEADER, rows)\n    code, _, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _accounts(store_open, ledger_store) == {\"Z\" * 12: \"n\" * 40}\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"bad\",\n    [\n        [\"zzlc1\", \"Lowercase Code\"],\n        [\"ABCDEFGHIJKLM\", \"Code Too Long\"],\n        [\"ZZ-1\", \"Bad Character\"],\n        [\"\", \"Empty Code\"],\n        [\"ZZL9\", \"\"],\n        [\"ZZL9\", \"x\" * 41],\n        [\"ZZL9\", \"has,comma\"],\n    ],\n)\ndef test_accounts_invalid_row_stores_nothing(ledger_store, store_open, tmp_path, bad):\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"accounts.csv\", ACCOUNT_HEADER, [[\"ZZLX1\", \"Valid First\"], bad])\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert _accounts(store_open, ledger_store) == {}\n\n\ndef test_accounts_duplicate_within_file_stores_nothing(ledger_store, store_open, tmp_path):\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"accounts.csv\", ACCOUNT_HEADER, [[\"ZLD1\", \"One\"], [\"ZLD2\", \"Two\"], [\"ZLD1\", \"Again\"]])\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert _accounts(store_open, ledger_store) == {}\n\n\ndef test_accounts_duplicate_of_stored_code_leaves_stored_row_unchanged(ledger_store, store_open, tmp_path):\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=\"ZLS1\", name=\"Already Stored\")\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"accounts.csv\", ACCOUNT_HEADER, [[\"ZLS2\", \"Fresh\"], [\"ZLS1\", \"Replacement\"]])\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert _accounts(store_open, ledger_store) == {\"ZLS1\": \"Already Stored\"}\n\n\ndef test_accounts_wrong_header_stores_nothing(ledger_store, store_open, tmp_path):\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"accounts.csv\", [\"code\", \"name\"], [[\"ZLH1\", \"Wrong Header\"]])\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert _accounts(store_open, ledger_store) == {}\n\n\ndef test_accounts_row_with_extra_field_stores_nothing(ledger_store, store_open, tmp_path):\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"accounts.csv\", ACCOUNT_HEADER, [[\"ZLF1\", \"Good\"], [\"ZLF2\", \"Too\", \"\"\"A storage failure on the third insert removes the first two, so the file loads nothing.\"\"\"\n    original = persistence_db.Database.run\n    creates = []\n\n    def failing_run(self, operation, arguments):\n        if operation.identifier == \"FEATURE-ACCOUNT-001\":\n            creates.append(arguments[\"account\"])\n            if len(creates) == 3:\n                raise PersistenceError(\"simulated write failure\")\n        return original(self, operation, arguments)\n\n    monkeypatch.setattr(persistence_db.Database, \"run\", failing_run)\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"accounts.csv\", ACCOUNT_HEADER, [[\"ZLW1\", \"One\"], [\"ZLW2\", \"Two\"], [\"ZLW3\", \"Three\"]])\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\n    monkeypatch.undo()\n    assert code == 1\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert _accounts(store_open, ledger_store) == {}\n\n\ndef test_accounts_usage_requires_exactly_one_file(ledger_store):\n    for args in [(\"load\", \"accounts\"), (\"load\", \"accounts\", \"a.csv\", \"b.csv\")]:\n        code, out, _ = cli_runner(*args)\n        assert code == 2\n        assert out == \"\"\n\n\n# ── categories ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_categories_load_reports_count_and_reads_back(ledger_store, store_open, tmp_path):\n    rows = [[\"ZLC1\", \"Cat One\"], [\"ZLC2\", \"Cat Two\"]]\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"categories.csv\", CATEGORY_HEADER, rows)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"categories\", \"2\"]]\n    assert _categories(store_open, ledger_store) == {cat: text for cat, text in rows}\n\n\ndef test_categories_header_only_loads_zero_rows(ledger_store, tmp_path):\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"categories.csv\", CATEGORY_HEADER, [])\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out) == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"categories\", \"0\"]]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"bad\",\n    [\n        [\"zlk1\", \"Lowercase\"],\n        [\"ABCDEFGHIJKLM\", \"Too Long Code\"],\n        [\"\", \"Empty Code\"],\n        [\"ZLK9\", \"\"],\n        [\"ZLK9\", \"x\" * 41],\n        [\"ZLK9\", \"has,comma\"],\n    ],\n)\ndef test_categories_invalid_row_stores_nothing(ledger_store, store_open, tmp_path, bad):\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"categories.csv\", CATEGORY_HEADER, [[\"ZLKX1\", \"Valid First\"], bad])\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert _categories(store_open, ledger_store) == {}\n\n\ndef test_categories_duplicate_of_stored_code_is_rejected(ledger_store, store_open, tmp_path):\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"ZLKS\", description=\"Already Stored\")\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"categories.csv\", CATEGORY_HEADER, [[\"ZLKF\", \"Fresh\"], [\"ZLKS\", \"Replacement\"]])\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert _categories(store_open, ledger_store) == {\"ZLKS\": \"Already Stored\"}\n\n\ndef test_categories_duplicate_within_file_is_rejected(ledger_store, store_open, tmp_path):\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"categories.csv\", CATEGORY_HEADER, [[\"ZLKD\", \"One\"], [\"ZLKD\", \"Again\"]])\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", path)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert _categories(store_open, ledger_store) == {}\n\n\ndef test_categories_wrong_header_is_rejected(ledger_store, tmp_path):\n    path = _write(tmp_path / \"categories.csv\", [\"category\", \"name\"], [[\"ZLKH\", \"Wrong\"]])\n    code, out, _ = {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgSvhfB9ZMUUQnMJ42qe7","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01DwHGYLuHssK7GZ86n521wz","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/tests/test_account_manage.py","content":"\"\"\"``ledger account get``, ``rename``, and ``delete``, against a fresh store per test.\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nACCOUNT_HEADER = [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\nCATEGORY = \"ZMAC1\"\n\n\ndef _rows(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef _name(store_open, path, code):\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        row = db.accounts.get(account=code)\n        return None if row is None else row.name\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef account_store(ledger_store, store_open):\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        db.categories.create(category=CATEGORY, description=\"Manage Category\")\n    return ledger_store\n\n\ndef _post(store_open, path, code, txn_id, cents):\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=txn_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=code, category=CATEGORY, amount=cents, memo=\"\")\n\n\n# ── get ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_get_reports_live_count_and_balance(account_store, store_open):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZMG1\", \"Get Probe\")\n    _post(store_open, account_store, \"ZMG1\", 1, 1000)\n    _post(store_open, account_store, \"ZMG1\", 2, -250)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", \"ZMG1\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [ACCOUNT_HEADER, [\"ZMG1\", \"Get Probe\", \"2\", \"7.50\"]]\n\n\ndef test_get_empty_account_reports_zero_count_and_zero_balance(account_store):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZMG2\", \"Empty Probe\")\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", \"ZMG2\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out)[1] == [\"ZMG2\", \"Empty Probe\", \"0\", \"0.00\"]\n\n\ndef test_get_reflects_a_posting_made_after_the_last_read(account_store, store_open):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZMG3\", \"Live\")\n    assert _rows(cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", \"ZMG3\")[1])[1] == [\"ZMG3\", \"Live\", \"0\", \"0.00\"]\n    _post(store_open, account_store, \"ZMG3\", 5, 4200)\n    assert _rows(cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", \"ZMG3\")[1])[1] == [\"ZMG3\", \"Live\", \"1\", \"42.00\"]\n\n\ndef test_get_absent_exits_four_with_no_stdout(account_store):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", \"ZMGNONE\")\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\ndef test_get_does_not_write(account_store, store_open):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZMG4\", \"Read Only\")\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", \"ZMG4\")\n    with store_open(account_store) as db:\n        assert [row.account for row in db.accounts.list()] == [\"ZMG4\"]\n        assert db.transactions.list() == []\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"args\", [(\"account\", \"get\"), (\"account\", \"get\", \"ZMG5\", \"EXTRA\")])\ndef test_get_wrong_argument_count_is_usage_error(account_store, args):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(*args)\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\n# ── rename ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_rename_prints_updated_row_and_persists_new_name(account_store, store_open):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZMR1\", \"Old Name\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"rename\", \"ZMR1\", \"New Name\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [ACCOUNT_HEADER, [\"ZMR1\", \"New Name\", \"0\", \"0.00\"]]\n    assert _name(store_open, account_store, \"ZMR1\") == \"New Name\"\n\n\ndef test_rename_changes_only_the_name(account_store, store_open):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZMR2\", \"Before\")\n    _post(store_open, account_store, \"ZMR2\", 7, 1250)\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"rename\", \"ZMR2\", \"After\")\n    with store_open(account_store) as db:\n        row = db.accounts.get(account=\"ZMR2\")\n        assert row.account == \"ZMR2\"\n        assert row.name == \"After\"\n        posted = db.transactions.list(account=\"ZMR2\")\n        assert [(t.txn_id, t.amount) for t in posted] == [(7, 1250)]\n\n\ndef test_rename_to_largest_name_is_stored_whole(account_store, store_open):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZMR3\", \"Short\")\n    code, _, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"rename\", \"ZMR3\", \"n\" * 40)\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _name(store_open, account_store, \"ZMR3\") == \"n\" * 40\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"bad\", [\"has,comma\", \"\", \"x\" * 41, \"line\\nbreak\"])\ndef test_rename_invalid_name_exits_three_and_keeps_name(account_store, store_open, bad):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZMR4\", \"Keep Me\")\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"rename\", \"ZMR4\", bad)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert _name(store_open, account_store, \"ZMR4\") == \"Keep Me\"\n\n\ndef test_rename_absent_exits_four_and_creates_nothing(account_store, store_open):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"rename\", \"ZMRNONE\", \"Any Name\")\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert _name(store_open, account_store, \"ZMRNONE\") is None\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"args\", [(\"account\", \"rename\", \"ZMR5\"), (\"account\", \"rename\", \"ZMR5\", \"A\", \"B\")])\ndef test_rename_wrong_argument_count_is_usage_error(account_store, args):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(*args)\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\n# ── delete ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_delete_without_transactions_prints_confirmation_and_removes(account_store, store_open):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZMD1\", \"Delete Me\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"delete\", \"ZMD1\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [[\"deleted\"], [\"ZMD1\"]]\n    assert _name(store_open, account_store, \"ZMD1\") is None\n\n\ndef test_delete_leaves_other_accounts_untouched(account_store, store_open):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\nCATEGORY = \"ZMAC1\"\n\n\ndef _rows(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef _name(store_open, path, code):\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        row = db.accounts.get(account=code)\n        return None if row is None else row.name\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef account_store(ledger_store, store_open):\n    with with store_open(path) as db:\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=txn_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=code, category=CATEGORY, amount=cents, memo=\"\")\n\n\n# ── get ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_get_reports_live_count_and_balance(account_store, store_open):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZMG1\", \"Get Probe\")\n    _post(store_open, account_store, \"ZMG1\", 1, 1000)\n    _post(store_open, account_store, \"ZMG1\", 2, -250)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", \"ZMG1\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [ACCOUNT_HEADER, [\"ZMG1\", \"Get Probe\", \"2\", \"7.50\"]]\n\n\ndef test_get_empty_account_reports_zero_count_and_zero_balance(account_store):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZMG2\", \"Empty Probe\")\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", \"ZMG2\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out)[1] == [\"ZMG2\", \"Empty Probe\", \"0\", \"0.00\"]\n\n\ndef test_get_reflects_a_posting_made_after_the_last_read(account_store, store_open):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZMG3\", \"Live\")\n    assert _rows(cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", \"ZMG3\")[1])[1] == [\"ZMG3\", \"Live\", \"0\", \"0.00\"]\n    _post(store_open, account_store, \"ZMG3\", 5, 4200)\n    assert _rows(cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", \"ZMG3\")[1])[1] == [\"ZMG3\", \"Live\", \"1\", \"42.00\"]\n\n\ndef test_get_absent_exits_four_with_no_stdout(account_store):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", \"ZMGNONE\")\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\ndef test_get_does_not_write(account_store, store_open):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZMG4\", \"Read Only\")\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", \"ZMG4\")\n    with store_open(account_store) as db:\n        assert [row.account for row in db.accounts.list()] == [\"ZMG4\"]\n        assert db.transactions.list() == []\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"args\", [(\"account\", \"get\"), (\"account\", \"get\", \"ZMG5\", \"EXTRA\")])\ndef test_get_wrong_argument_count_is_usage_error(account_store, args):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(*args)\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\n# ── rename ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_rename_prints_updated_row_and_persists_new_name(account_store, store_open):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZMR1\", \"Old Name\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"rename\", \"ZMR1\", \"New Name\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [ACCOUNT_HEADER, [\"ZMR1\", \"New Name\", \"0\", \"0.00\"]]\n    assert _name(store_open, account_store, \"ZMR1\") == \"New Name\"\n\n\ndef test_rename_changes_only_the_name(account_store, store_open):\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZMR2\", \"Before\")\n    _post(store_open, account_store, \"ZMR2\", 7, 1250)\n    cli_runner(\"account\", \"rename\", \"ZMR2\", \"After\")\n    with store_open(account_store) as db:\n        row = db.accounts.get(account=\"ZMR2\")\n        assert row.account == \"ZMR2\"\n        assert row.name == \"After\"\n        posted = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"ZMR3\", \"Short\")\n    code, _, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"rename\", \"ZMR3\", \"n\" * 40)\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _name(store_open, account_store, \"ZMR3\") == \"n\" * 40\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"bad\", [\"has,comma\", \"\", \"x\" * 41, \"line\\nbreak\"])\ndef txn get``, ``delete``, and ``amend``, against a fresh store per test.\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nTXN_HEADER = [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\nACCOUNT = \"ZTA1\"\nCATEGORY = \"ZTC1\"\n\n\ndef _rows(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef txn_store(ledger_store, store_open):\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=ACCOUNT, name=\"Txn Probe\")\n        db.categories.create(category=CATEGORY, description=\"Txn Category\")\n    return ledger_store\n\n\ndef _add(store_open, path, txn_id, amount, date=\"2026-04-01\", memo=\"\"):\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=txn_id, date=date, account=ACCOUNT, category=CATEGORY, amount=amount, memo=memo)\n\n\ndef _stored(store_open, path, txn_id):\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        return db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n\n\n# ── get ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_get_prints_every_column_with_two_decimal_amount(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 101, 1234, date=\"2026-04-05\", memo=\"get probe\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"101\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [TXN_HEADER, [\"101\", \"2026-04-05\", ACCOUNT, CATEGORY, \"12.34\", \"get probe\"]]\n\n\ndef test_get_negative_amount_has_leading_minus(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 102, -1250)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"102\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out)[1][4] == \"-12.50\"\n\n\ndef test_get_whole_amount_has_two_decimals(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 103, 500)\n    assert _rows(cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"103\")[1])[1][4] == \"5.00\"\n\n\ndef test_get_is_read_only(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 104, 700)\n    cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"104\")\n    stored = _stored(store_open, txn_store, 104)\n    assert stored.amount == 700\n    with store_open(txn_store) as db:\n        assert len(db.transactions.list()) == 1\n\n\ndef test_get_absent_exits_four_with_no_stdout(txn_store):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"999999991\")\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"bad\", [\"abc\", \"1.5\", \"\", \"12 3\"])\ndef test_get_non_integer_id_exits_three(txn_store, bad):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", bad)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"args\", [(\"txn\", \"get\"), (\"txn\", \"get\", \"1\", \"2\")])\ndef test_get_wrong_argument_count_is_usage_error(txn_store, args):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(*args)\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\n# ── delete ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_delete_prints_confirmation_and_removes_row(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 201, -500)\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 202, 9000)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"201\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [[\"deleted\"], [\"201\"]]\n    assert _stored(store_open, txn_store, 201) is None\n    assert _stored(store_open, txn_store, 202).amount == 9000\n\n\ndef test_delete_of_deposit_is_refused_when_payment_would_overdraw(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 203, 10000)\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 204, -4000)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"203\")\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert _stored(store_open, txn_store, 203).amount == 10000\n\n\ndef test_delete_of_payment_that_leaves_balance_positive_succeeds(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 205, 10000)\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 206, -4000)\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"206\")[0] == 0\n    assert _stored(store_open, txn_store, 206) is None\n\n\ndef test_delete_leaving_exactly_zero_is_allowed(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 207, 4000)\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 208, -4000)\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"207\")[0] == 0\n\n\ndef test_delete_absent_exits_four_with_no_stdout(txn_store):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"999999992\")\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\ndef test_delete_twice_second_attempt_exits_four(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 209, 300)\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"209\")[0] == 0\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"209\")[0] == 4\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"bad\", [\"abc\", \"2.5\"])\ndef test_delete_non_integer_id_exits_three(txn_store, bad):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", bad)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"args\", [(\"txn\", \"delete\"), (\"txn\", \"delete\", \"1\", \"2\")])\ndef test_delete_wrong_argument_count_is_usage_error(txn_store, args):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(*args)\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\n# ── amend ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_amend_prints_updated_row_and_persists_new_amount(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 301, 10000, memo=\"amend probe\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"301\", \"50.00\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [TXN_HEADER, [\"301\", \"2026-04-01\", ACCOUNT, CATEGORY, \"50.00\", \"amend probe\"]]\n    assert _stored(store_open, txn_store, 301).amount == 5000\n\n\ndef test_amend_changes_only_the_amount(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 302, 2000, date=\"2026-05-02\", memo=\"keep this memo\")\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"302\", \"35.50\")[0] == 0\n    back = _stored(store_open, txn_store, 302)\n    assert back.date == \"2026-05-02\"\n    assert back.account == ACCOUNT\n    assert back.category == CATEGORY\n    assert back.memo == \"keep this memo\"\n    assert back.amount == 3550\n\n\ndef test_amend_to_negative_amount_is_accepted_when_balance_allows(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 303, 10000)\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 304, -4000)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"303\", \"-10.00\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out)[1][4] == \"-10.00\"\n\n\ndef test_amend_that_overdraws_exits_three_and_keeps_amount(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 305, 10000)\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 306, -4000)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"305\", \"30.00\")\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert _stored(store_open, txn_store, 305).amount == 10000\n\n\ndef test_amend_landing_exactly_on_zero_succeeds(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 307, 10000)\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 308, -4000)\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", txn get``, ``delete``, and ``amend``, against a fresh store per test.\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nTXN_HEADER = [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\nACCOUNT = \"ZTA1\"\nCATEGORY = \"ZTC1\"\n\n\ndef _rows(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef txn_store(ledger_store, store_open):\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=ACCOUNT, name=\"Txn Probe\")\n        db.categories.create(category=CATEGORY, description=\"Txn Category\")\n    return ledger_store\n\n\ndef _add(store_open, path, txn_id, amount, date=\"2026-04-01\", memo=\"\"):\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=txn_id, date=date, account=ACCOUNT, category=CATEGORY, amount=amount, memo=memo)\n\n\ndef _stored(store_open, path, txn_id):\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        return db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n\n\n# ── get ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_get_prints_every_column_with_two_decimal_amount(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 101, 1234, date=\"2026-04-05\", memo=\"get probe\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"101\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [TXN_HEADER, [\"101\", \"2026-04-05\", ACCOUNT, CATEGORY, \"12.34\", \"get probe\"]]\n\n\ndef test_get_negative_amount_has_leading_minus(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 102, -1250)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"102\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out)[1][4] == \"-12.50\"\n\n\ndef test_get_whole_amount_has_two_decimals(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 103, 500)\n    assert _rows(cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"103\")[1])[1][4] == \"5.00\"\n\n\ndef test_get_is_read_only(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 104, 700)\n    cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"104\")\n    stored = _stored(store_open, txn_store, 104)\n    assert stored.amount == 700\n    with store_open(txn_store) as db:\n        assert len(db.transactions.list()) == 1\n\n\ndef test_get_absent_exits_four_with_no_stdout(txn_store):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"999999991\")\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"bad\", [\"abc\", \"1.5\", \"\", \"12 3\"])\ndef test_get_non_integer_id_exits_three(txn_store, bad):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", bad)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"args\", [(\"txn\", \"get\"), (\"txn\", \"get\", \"1\", \"2\")])\ndef test_get_wrong_argument_count_is_usage_error(txn_store, args):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(*args)\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\n# ── delete ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_delete_prints_confirmation_and_removes_row(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 201, -500)\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 202, 9000)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"201\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [[\"deleted\"], [\"201\"]]\n    assert _stored(store_open, txn_store, 201) is None\n    assert _stored(store_open, txn_store, 202).amount == 9000\n\n\ndef test_delete_of_deposit_is_refused_when_payment_would_overdraw(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 203, 10000)\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 204, -4000)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"203\")\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert _stored(store_open, txn_store, 203).amount == 10000\n\n\ndef test_delete_of_payment_that_leaves_balance_positive_succeeds(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 205, 10000)\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 206, -4000)\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"206\")[0] == 0\n    assert _stored(store_open, txn_store, 206) is None\n\n\ndef test_delete_leaving_exactly_zero_is_allowed(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 207, 4000)\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 208, -4000)\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"207\")[0] == 0\n\n\ndef test_delete_absent_exits_four_with_no_stdout(txn_store):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"999999992\")\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\ndef test_delete_twice_second_attempt_exits_four(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 209, 300)\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"209\")[0] == 0\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"209\")[0] == 4\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"bad\", [\"abc\", \"2.5\"])\ndef test_delete_non_integer_id_exits_three(txn_store, bad):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", bad)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"args\", [(\"txn\", \"delete\"), (\"txn\", \"delete\", \"1\", \"2\")])\ndef test_delete_wrong_argument_count_is_usage_error(txn_store, args):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(*args)\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\n# ── amend ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_amend_prints_updated_row_and_persists_new_amount(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 301, 10000, memo=\"amend probe\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"301\", \"50.00\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [TXN_HEADER, [\"301\", \"2026-04-01\", ACCOUNT, CATEGORY, \"50.00\", \"amend probe\"]]\n    assert _stored(store_open, txn_store, 301).amount == 5000\n\n\ndef test_amend_changes_only_the_amount(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 302, 2000, date=\"2026-05-02\", memo=\"keep this memo\")\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"302\", \"35.50\")[0] == 0\n    back = _stored(store_open, txn_store, 302)\n    assert back.date == \"2026-05-02\"\n    assert back.account == ACCOUNT\n    assert back.category == CATEGORY\n    assert back.memo == \"keep this memo\"\n    assert back.amount == 3550\n\n\ndef test_amend_to_negative_amount_is_accepted_when_balance_allows(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 303, 10000)\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 304, -4000)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"303\", \"-10.00\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out)[1][4] == \"-10.00\"\n\n\ndef test_amend_that_overdraws_exits_three_and_keeps_amount(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 305, 10000)\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 306, -4000)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"305\", \"30.00\")\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert _stored(store_open, txn_store, 305).amount == 10000\n\n\ndef test_amend_landing_exactly_on_zero_succeeds(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 307, 10000)\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 308, -4000)\n    assert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"307\", \"40.00\")[0] == 0\n    assert _stored(store_open, txn_store, 307).amount == 4000\n\n\ndef test_amend_absent_exits_four_and_creates_nothing(txn_store, store_open):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"999999993\", \"5.00\")\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert _stored(store_open, txn_store, 999999993) is None\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"bad\", [\"1.234\", \"0\", \"0.00\", \"abc\", \"5.\", \"\"])\ndef test_amend_invalid_amount_exits_three_and_keeps_amount(txn_store, store_open, bad):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 309, 10000)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"309\", bad)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert _stored(store_open, txn_store, 309).amount == 10000\n\n\ndef test_amend_non_integer_id_exits_three(txn_store):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"abc\", \"5.00\")\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"args\", [(\"txn\", \"amend\"), (\"txn\", \"amend\", \"1\"), (\"txn\", \"amend\", \"1\", \"2.00\", \"x\")])\ndef test_amend_wrong_argument_count_is_usage_error(txn_store, args):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(*args)\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n"}}}

list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef txn_store(ledger_store, store_open):\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=ACCOUNT, name=\"Txn Probe\")\n        db.categories.create(category=CATEGORY, description=\"Txn Category\")\n    return ledger_store\n\n\ndef _add(store_open, path, txn_id, amount, date=\"2026-04-01\", memo=\"\"):\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=txn_id, date=date, account=ACCOUNT, category=CATEGORY, amount=amount, memo=memo)\n\n\ndef _stored(store_open, path, txn_id):\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        return db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n\n\n# ── get ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_get_prints_every_column_with_two_decimal_amount(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 101, 1234, date=\"2026-04-05\", memo=\"get probe\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"101\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [TXN_HEADER, [\"101\", \"2026-04-05\", ACCOUNT, CATEGORY, \"12.34\", \"get probe\"]]\n\n\ndef test_get_negative_amount_has_leading_minus(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 102, -1250)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"102\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out)[1][4] == \"-12.50\"\n\n\ndef test_get_whole_amount_has_two_decimals(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 103, 500)\n    assert _rows(cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"103\")[1])[1][4] == \"5.00\"\n\n\ndef test_get_is_read_only(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 104, 700)\n    cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"104\")\n    stored = _stored(store_open, txn_store, 104)\n    assert stored.amount == 700\n    with store_open(txn_store) as db:\n        assert len(db.transactions.list()) == 1\n\n\ndef test_get_absent_exits_four_with_no_stdout(txn_store):\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"999999991\")\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == test_delete_prints_confirmation_and_removes_row(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 201, -500)\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 202, 9000)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"201\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [[\"deleted\"], [\"201\"]]\n    assert _stored(store_open, txn_store, 201) is None\n    assert db.accounts.create(account=\"ZTFD\", name=\"Dest Account\")\n        db.categories.create(category=TRANSFER, description=\"Internal transfer\")\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=1, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=\"ZTFS\", category=TRANSFER, amount=100000, memo=\"funding\")\n    return ledger_store\n\n\ndef _rows(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"ZTFS\", \"ZTFD\", \"250.00\", \"2026-05-10\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [\n        TXN_HEADER,\n        [\"2\", \"2026-05-10\", \"ZTFS\", TRANSFER, \"-250.00\", \"transfer to ZTFD\"],\n        [\"3\", \"2026-05-10\", \"ZTFD\", TRANSFER, \"250.00\", \"transfer from ZTFS\"],\n    ]\n\n\ndef test_transfer_rows_read_back_from_the_store(transfer_store, store_open):\n    cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"ZTFS\", \"ZTFD\", \"250.00\", \"2026-05-10\")\n    with store_open(transfer_store) as db:\n        outgoing = db.transactions.get(txn_id=2)\n        incoming = db.transactions.get(txn_id=3)\n    assert outgoing.amount == -25000 and outgoing.account == \"ZTFS\"\n    assert incoming.amount == 25000 and incoming.account == \"ZTFD\"\n    assert outgoing.category == incoming.category == TRANSFER\n\n\ndef test_transfer_conserves_cash_across_the_two_accounts(transfer_store, store_open):\n    before = _balance(store_open, transfer_store, \"ZTFS\") + _balance(store_open, transfer_store, \"ZTFD\")\n    assert cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"ZTFS\", \"ZTFD\", \"123.45\", \"2026-05-11\")[0] == 0\n    after = _balance(store_open, transfer_store, \"ZTFS\") + _balance(store_open, transfer_store, \"ZTFD\")\n    assert after == before\n    assert _balance(store_open, transfer_store, \"ZTFS\") == 100000 - 12345\n    assert _balance(store_open, transfer_store, \"ZTFD\") == 12345\n\n\ndef test_transfer_ids_follow_largest_stored_id_not_row_count(transfer_store, store_open):\n    with store_open(transfer_store) as db:\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=50, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=\"ZTFD\", category=TRANSFER, amount=100, memo=\"\")\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"ZTFS\", \"ZTFD\", \"1.00\", \"2026-05-12\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert [row[0] for row in _rows(out)[1:]] == [\"51\", \"52\"]\n\n\ndef test_transfer_of_exact_balance_leaves_source_at_zero(transfer_store, store_open):\n    code, _, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"ZTFS\", \"ZTFD\", \"1000.00\", \"2026-05-12\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _balance(store_open, transfer_store, \"ZTFS\") == 0\n\n\ndef test_transfer_one_cent_over_balance_exits_three_and_stores_neither_row(transfer_store, store_open):\n    before = \"5.00\", \"2026-05-13\"),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_rejected_transfer_exits_three_with_no_output_and_no_rows(transfer_store, store_open, args):\n    before = len(_all(store_open, transfer_store))\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"transfer\", *args)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(_all(store_open, transfer_store)) == before\n\n\ndef date=\"2026-05-01\", account=\"ZTNS\", category=\"ZTNC\", amount=900, memo=\"\")","originalFile":"\"\"\"``ledger transfer``: two linked rows stored together or not at all, against a fresh store per test.\"\"\"\n\nimport csv\nimport io\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nTXN_HEADER = [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\nTRANSFER = \"TRANSFER\"\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef transfer_store(ledger_store, store_open):\n    \"\"\"Two accounts, the TRANSFER category, and a funded source account.\"\"\"\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=\"ZTFS\", name=\"Source Account\")\n        db.accounts.create(account=\"ZTFD\", name=\"Dest Account\")\n        db.categories.create(category=TRANSFER, description=\"Internal transfer\")\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=1, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=\"ZTFS\", category=TRANSFER, amount=100000, memo=\"funding\")\n    return ledger_store\n\n\ndef _rows(out: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n\n\ndef _all(store_open, path):\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        return db.transactions.list()\n\n\ndef _balance(store_open, path, account):\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        return sum(row.amount for row in db.transactions.list(account=account))\n\n\ndef test_transfer_prints_two_rows_with_consecutive_ids(transfer_store, store_open):\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"ZTFS\", \"ZTFD\", \"250.00\", \"2026-05-10\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [\n        TXN_HEADER,\n        [\"2\", \"2026-05-10\", \"ZTFS\", TRANSFER, \"-250.00\", \"transfer to ZTFD\"],\n        [\"3\", \"2026-05-10\", \"ZTFD\", TRANSFER, \"250.00\", \"transfer from ZTFS\"],\n    ]\n\n\ndef test_transfer_rows_read_back_from_the_store(transfer_store, store_open):\n    cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"ZTFS\", \"ZTFD\", \"250.00\", \"2026-05-10\")\n    with store_open(transfer_store) as db:\n        outgoing = db.transactions.get(txn_id=2)\n        incoming = db.transactions.get(txn_id=3)\n    assert outgoing.amount == -25000 and outgoing.account == \"ZTFS\"\n    assert incoming.amount == 25000 and incoming.account == \"ZTFD\"\n    assert outgoing.category == incoming.category == TRANSFER\n\n\ndef test_transfer_conserves_cash_across_the_two_accounts(transfer_store, store_open):\n    before = _balance(store_open, transfer_store, \"ZTFS\") + _balance(store_open, transfer_store, \"ZTFD\")\n txn_store(ledger_store, store_open):\n    with store_open(ledger_store) as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=ACCOUNT, name=\"Txn Probe\")\n        db.categories.create(category=CATEGORY, description=\"Txn Category\")\n    return ledger_store\n\n\ndef _add(store_open, path, txn_id, amount, date=\"2026-04-01\", memo=\"\"):\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=txn_id, date=date, account=ACCOUNT, category=CATEGORY, amount=amount, memo=memo)\n\n\ndef _stored(store_open, path, txn_id):\n    with store_open(path) as db:\n        return db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n\n\n# ── get ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\ndef test_get_prints_every_column_with_two_decimal_amount(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 101, 1234, date=\"2026-04-05\", memo=\"get probe\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"101\")\n    assert code == 0, err\n    assert _rows(out) == [TXN_HEADER, [\"101\", \"2026-04-05\", ACCOUNT, CATEGORY, \"12.34\", \"get probe\"]]\n\n\ndef test_get_negative_amount_has_leading_minus(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 102, -1250)\n    code, out, _ = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"102\")\n    assert code == 0\n    assert _rows(out)[1][4] == \"-12.50\"\n\n\ndef test_get_whole_amount_has_two_decimals(txn_store, store_open):\n    _add(store_open, txn_store, 103, 500)\n    assert _rows(cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", An exact zero balance is allowed.\n- **`transfer`**: checks everything, including the source balance after the debit, then writes two rows with consecutive ids. Both rows print.\n- Test runs: `sh bin/test.sh` → 365 passed, exit 0. `sh sources/run.sh` → 23 of 43 passed, exit 1 (failures explained above).\n\nChoices I made where the spec was silent or the library fell short:\n1. **Atomicity by compensation, not a real transaction.** The shipped persistence layer autocommits every operation and exposes no transaction scope. I validate everything first, then insert in order and undo on failure. A failure during the undo itself would still leave partial rows. Real atomicity would need a transaction API in the shipped persistence package.\n2. **Transaction ids accept an optional leading minus** (`-?[0-9]+`). A negative id is then absent and exits 4, not 3.\n3. **The category description reuses the name validator.** Only the diagnostic wording differs, not the rule.\n\nNot run: the Programmatic Acceptance blocks in the spec are for Drydock's harness to execute. I did not run them.
